records.context: **Pure uncertainty ranking collapses onto one region of feature space.** The 100 most uncertain extracted image regions on a real laboratory microplate are routinely 100 near copies from the same two microplate sample positions — one ambiguity, labelled a hundred times, for almost the information of labelling it once. So the annotation work list is diversified by default (round-robin across microplate sample positions) and :func:`format_queue_summary` prints how many microplate sample positions the annotation work list actually covers. What that costs is stated plainly in :func:`build_queue`.
records.label: spacr.active_learning#9
records.source: **Pure uncertainty ranking collapses onto one region of feature space.** The 100 most uncertain crops on a real plate are routinely 100 near copies from the same two wells — one ambiguity, labelled a hundred times, for almost the information of labelling it once. So the queue is diversified by default (round-robin across wells) and :func:`format_queue_summary` prints how many wells the queue actually covers. What that costs is stated plainly in :func:`build_queue`.
records.translation: **Ren osäkerhet rankning kollapsar på en region av egenskapsrymd.** De 100 mest osäkra extraherade bild regioner på en verklig laboratorie mikroplatta är rutinmässigt 100 nära kopior från samma två mikroplate provpositioner - en tvetydighet, märkt hundra gånger, för nästan informationen om märkning det en gång. Så annotation arbetslistan är diversifierad som standard (rund-robin över mikroplates provpositioner) och :func:`format_queue_summary` skriver ut hur många mikroplatte prov positioner annotering arbetslistan faktiskt täcker. Vad det kostar anges tydligt i :func:`build_queue`.

records.context: **Determinism.** Same inputs, same seed, same order — including ties. Ties break on row index by default; ``seed`` swaps in a seeded permutation, which is still reproducible. Nothing here consults an unseeded RNG.
records.label: spacr.active_learning#11
records.source: **Determinism.** Same inputs, same seed, same order — including ties. Ties break on row index by default; ``seed`` swaps in a seeded permutation, which is still reproducible. Nothing here consults an unseeded RNG.
records.translation: **Determinism.** Samma ingångar, samma frö, samma ordning – inklusive band. Knytningar bryter på radindex som standard; ``seed`` swappar i en permutation med frö, som fortfarande är reproducerbar. Ingenting här konsulterar en osetad RNG.

records.context: **The annotation work list is diversified by default, and that costs something.** With ``diversity='well'`` the ranked extracted image regions are dealt round-robin across microplate sample positions: position 1 is still the single most uncertain extracted image region, but position 2 is the most uncertain extracted image region in a *different* well, which may be materially less uncertain than the runner-up overall. You give up some per-item uncertainty to stop the annotator labelling the same ambiguity a hundred times — the failure mode of pure uncertainty sampling, where the top 100 extracted image regions routinely come from two microplate sample positions. If ``limit`` is smaller than the number of microplate sample positions, the annotation work list will contain roughly one extracted image region from each of ``limit`` microplate sample positions and none from the rest. Pass ``diversity='none'`` for the pure order, ``'field'``/``'plate'`` for other strata, or ``group_columns=[…]`` for your own — including a cluster id you computed from features, which is the more thorough diversification this trades away for not needing a feature matrix.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.build_queue#3
records.source: **The queue is diversified by default, and that costs something.** With ``diversity='well'`` the ranked crops are dealt round-robin across wells: position 1 is still the single most uncertain crop, but position 2 is the most uncertain crop in a *different* well, which may be materially less uncertain than the runner-up overall. You give up some per-item uncertainty to stop the annotator labelling the same ambiguity a hundred times — the failure mode of pure uncertainty sampling, where the top 100 crops routinely come from two wells. If ``limit`` is smaller than the number of wells, the queue will contain roughly one crop from each of ``limit`` wells and none from the rest. Pass ``diversity='none'`` for the pure order, ``'field'``/``'plate'`` for other strata, or ``group_columns=[…]`` for your own — including a cluster id you computed from features, which is the more thorough diversification this trades away for not needing a feature matrix.
records.translation: **Annotationsarbetslistan är varierad som standard, och det kostar något.** Med ``diversity='well'`` de rangordnade extraherade bildregioner delas rund-robin över mikroplattor provpositioner: position 1 är fortfarande den enda mest osäkra extraherade bilden region, men position 2 är den mest osäkra utvunna bildregionen i en *different* brunn, som kan vara betydligt mindre osäker än den löpare-up övergripande. Du ger upp några per-punkt osäkerhet för att stoppa annotatorn märkning samma tvetydighet hundra gånger - misslyckandet med ren osäkerhet provtagning, där topp 100 extraherade bilder regioner rutinmässigt kommer från två mikroplate provpositioner. Om ``limit`` är mindre än antalet mikroplattors provpositioner, kommer annoteringsarbetslistan att innehålla ungefär ett extraherat bildområde från var och en av ``limit`` mikroplattornas provpositioner och ingen från resten. Passera ``diversity='none'`` för den rena ordningen, ``'field'``/ ``'plate'`` för andra skikt, eller ``group_columns=[…]`` för din egen – inklusive ett kluster- id som du har räknat ut från egenskaper, vilket är den mer genomgripande diversifieringen som detta avhandlar bort för att inte behöva en egenskapsmatris.

records.translation: **En omärkt cell är en nedlagd röst, inte en oenighet.** Varje par poängsätts på raderna *både* annotatorer märkta (parvis kompletta fall). records.context: ``NAN_DROP_FEATURES`` drop any feature column containing a NaN. On a real database it often removes every ``pathogen_*`` column, because those columns are NaN for cells without a pathogen. ``NAN_DROP_OBJECTS`` drop any object row containing a NaN. Usually removes almost everything, for the same reason; offered because on a single-object-type export it is often exactly right. ``NAN_ZERO`` / ``NAN_MEAN`` impute. Vanligtvis tar bort nästan allt, av samma anledning; erbjuds eftersom på en enda-objekt-typ export är det ofta exakt rätt. ``NAN_ZERO`` / ``NAN_MEAN`` impute. Båda skriver en ``layers['missing']`` boolean mask av samma form som standard, så imputerade värden kan berättas bortsett från uppmätta; booleanska mask kostar 1 byte per cell mot 4 för standard ``float32`` ``X``.

records.context: **Infinities are treated as missing under every policy.** spaCR produces +/-inf from ratio features (a denominator of zero), and an inf survives ``dropna`` while destroying any scaling, PCA or distance computed from it. They are converted to NaN before the policy runs and counted separately in ``uns['spacr']['nan']['n_infinite']`` so the substitution is never silent.
records.label: spacr.anndata_export#16
records.source: **Infinities are treated as missing under every policy.** spaCR produces +/-inf from ratio features (a denominator of zero), and an inf survives ``dropna`` while destroying any scaling, PCA or distance computed from it. They are converted to NaN before the policy runs and counted separately in ``uns['spacr']['nan']['n_infinite']`` so the substitution is never silent.
records.translation: **Infiniteter behandlas som saknas under varje policy.** spaCR producerar +/-inf från förhållandet egenskaper (en nämnare för noll), och en inf överlever ``dropna`` medan du förstör någon skalning, PCA eller avstånd beräknas från den. De omvandlas till NaN innan policyn körs och räknas separat i ``uns['spacr']['nan']['n_infinite']`` så att ersättningen aldrig är tyst.

records.context: :func:`spacr.io._read_and_join_tables` takes six named columns off ``png_list`` -- the object id, ``png_path`` and the four microscope field of view structured-data names -- and drops the rest. The rest is every annotation column the Annotate app added and every score the machine-learning classification model wrote, which for this export are among the most valuable columns in the database: without them ``obs`` has no label to train on, group by, or colour a UMAP with. They are re-attached by object identifier (:func:`_attach_png_labels`) *before* filtering, so a filter can name one -- "export the cells I annotated as infected" -- and they are separated into ``uns['spacr']['annotation_columns']`` and ``uns['spacr']['prediction_columns']`` using :mod:`spacr.agreement`'s own rule, which exists because a model's class column is indistinguishable *by shape* from an annotation pass.
records.label: spacr.anndata_export#28
records.source: :func:`spacr.io._read_and_join_tables` takes six named columns off ``png_list`` -- the object id, ``png_path`` and the four field keys -- and drops the rest. The rest is every annotation column the Annotate app added and every score the classifier wrote, which for this export are among the most valuable columns in the database: without them ``obs`` has no label to train on, group by, or colour a UMAP with. They are re-attached by object key (:func:`_attach_png_labels`) *before* filtering, so a filter can name one -- "export the cells I annotated as infected" -- and they are separated into ``uns['spacr']['annotation_columns']`` and ``uns['spacr']['prediction_columns']`` using :mod:`spacr.agreement`'s own rule, which exists because a model's class column is indistinguishable *by shape* from an annotation pass.
records.translation: :func:`spacr.io._read_and_join_tables` tar bort sex namngivna kolumner från ``png_list`` -- objektets id, ``png_path`` och det fyra mikroskopfältet med synstrukturerade datanamn -- och släpper resten. Resten är varje annoteringskolumn som Annotate-appen lagt till och varje poäng som maskininlärningsmodellen skrev, som för denna export är bland de mest värdefulla kolumnerna i databasen: utan dem ``obs`` har ingen etikett att träna på, gruppera efter eller färga en UMAP med. De är åter sammanfogade med objektidentifierare (:func:`_attach_png_labels`) *före* filtrering, så att ett filter kan namnge en -- "exportera cellerna som jag annoterade som infekterade" -- och de separeras till ``uns['spacr']['annotation_columns']`` och ``uns['spacr']['prediction_columns']`` med :mod:`spacr.agreement` egen regel, vilken existerar på grund av att en modells klasskolumn är oskiljbar *genom form* från ett noteringspass.

records.context: ``combat`` is the empirical-Bayes method of Johnson, Li & Rabinovich (2007). Unlike the four above it fits a *model*: every feature is regressed on batch indicators **and** on the biology named by ``covariate``, and only the batch part of that fit is removed. The per-batch location and scale are then shrunk toward the distribution of the same parameter across all features, which is what makes it usable on a laboratory microplate with few microplate sample positions where a per-feature estimate would be noise.
records.label: spacr.batch_correction.correct_batch_effects#2
records.source: ``combat`` is the empirical-Bayes method of Johnson, Li & Rabinovich (2007). Unlike the four above it fits a *model*: every feature is regressed on batch indicators **and** on the biology named by ``covariate``, and only the batch part of that fit is removed. The per-batch location and scale are then shrunk toward the distribution of the same parameter across all features, which is what makes it usable on a plate with few wells where a per-feature estimate would be noise.
records.translation: ``combat`` är den empiriska-Bayes metoden Johnson, Li & Rabinovich (2007). Till skillnad från de fyra ovan passar det en *modell*: varje egenskap regresseras på batch indikatorer **and** på biologin som namnges av ``covariate``, och bara bachen delen av den passformen tas bort. Per-batch plats och skala är sedan krympt mot fördelningen av samma parameter över alla egenskaper, vilket är vad som gör det användbart på ett laboratorium microplate med få mikroplate provpositioner där en per-feature uppskattning skulle vara buller.

records.context: This landing page currently serves two spaCR tiles.  **Mask** runs :func:`preprocess_generate_masks` to turn raw multichannel acquisitions into preprocessed arrays and Cellpose masks for cells, nuclei, pathogens, and organelles.  **Image UMAP** runs :func:`generate_image_umap` to reduce measured single-object features, cluster them, and optionally place representative extracted image regions on the embedding. records.source: This landing page currently serves two spaCR tiles.  **Mask** runs :func:`preprocess_generate_masks` to turn raw multichannel acquisitions into preprocessed arrays and Cellpose masks for cells, nuclei, pathogens, and organelles.  **Image UMAP** runs :func:`generate_image_umap` to reduce measured single-object features, cluster them, and optionally place representative image crops on the embedding.  The same module also exposes the timelapse-mask entry point; the two main workflows remain independent, and UMAP does not segment images.
records.translation: Denna landningssida betjänar för närvarande två brickor spaCR. **Mask** kör :func:`preprocess_generate_masks` för att förvandla råa flerkanalsförvärv till förbehandlade matriser och Cellpose masker för celler, nuklei, patogener och organeller. **Image UMAP** körs :func:`generate_image_umap` som reducerar uppmätta egenskaper för enskilda objekt, gruppera dem och placera tillval representativa extraherade bildregioner på inbäddningen. Samma modul exponerar också inmatningspunkten timelapse-mask; de två huvudflödena förblir oberoende, och UMAP placerar inte segmentbilder.

records.context: 1. **Flatten.** Denoise with a 1 px Gaussian, then subtract a heavily smoothed copy (sigma = max(32, min(H, W) / 4)) to remove illumination gradients. The sigma is deliberately far larger than any plausible object so that flattening removes vignetting without removing the objects — the opposite trade-off (a tight rolling ball) shrinks what it is trying to measure. 2. **Reject noise.** Compare the structural amplitude of the flattened plane (p99 - p30) against the *pixel-level* noise scale, measured as ``1.4826 * MAD(img - gaussian(img, 1))`` on the raw plane. A pure-noise plane scores below 1; a plane with real objects scores in the tens. Below ``min_snr`` the field is discarded rather than thresholded, because Otsu returns a threshold even for pure noise, and the resulting size looks valid. 3. **Threshold and label.** Otsu, fill holes, label, drop components that touch the image border (truncated, so their size is too small) and components that are absurd (equivalent diameter below ``min_object_diameter``, or area above ``max_object_fraction`` of the field). Sizes are equivalent diameters, ``2 * sqrt(area / pi)``. 4. **Drop specks, then take the median.** A textured or punctate stain (a mitochondrial cell stain, a parasite marker) thresholds into a few whole objects plus hundreds of 4-10 px specks, and a plain median counts every speck as an object: on spaCR's own test laboratory microplate that put the cell at 8 px and the pathogen at 11 px against 175 px and 32 px in the curated masks, while the nucleus, whose stain is solid, came out right at 91 px. So the typical object is first located by the stained area it carries (the area-weighted median, which specks cannot move because they hold almost no area), everything narrower than :data:`SPECK_FRACTION` of it is dropped, and the characteristic size is the median of what remains. Small components that together hold :data:`SPECK_MAX_AREA_SHARE` of the stained area or more are a second population, not specks, and stay. 5. **Cross-check by distance transform.** Step 3 has one dominant failure mode: a confluent monolayer fuses into a single component, that component touches the border and is dropped, and the estimate is then computed from whatever debris survived — biased **low**, and silently. So the Euclidean distance transform of the (unfilled) foreground is computed as well, its local maxima are taken as one seed per object (two passes: a coarse pass sets the suppression radius for the refined pass), and a watershed on ``-EDT`` splits the fused foreground back into objects whose equivalent diameters are measured the same way.
records.label: spacr.diameter#6

The sigma is deliberately far larger than any plausible object so that flattening removes vignetting without removing the objects — the opposite trade-off (a tight rolling ball) shrinks what it is trying to measure. 2. **Reject noise.** Compare the structural amplitude of the flattened plane (p99 - p30) against the *pixel-level* noise scale, measured as ``1.4826 * MAD(img - gaussian(img, 1))`` on the raw plane. A pure-noise plane scores below 1; a plane with real objects scores in the tens. Below ``min_snr`` the field is discarded rather than thresholded, because Otsu returns a threshold even for pure noise, and the resulting size looks valid. 3. **Threshold and label.** Otsu, fill holes, label, drop components that touch the image border (truncated, so their size is too small) and components that are absurd (equivalent diameter below ``min_object_diameter``, or area above ``max_object_fraction`` of the field). Sizes are equivalent diameters, ``2 * sqrt(area / pi)``. 4. **Drop specks, then take the median.** A textured or punctate stain (a mitochondrial cell stain, a parasite marker) thresholds into a few whole objects plus hundreds of 4-10 px specks, and a plain median counts every speck as an object: on spaCR's own test plate that put the cell at 8 px and the pathogen at 11 px against 175 px and 32 px in the curated masks, while the nucleus, whose stain is solid, came out right at 91 px. So the typical object is first located by the stained area it carries (the area-weighted median, which specks cannot move because they hold almost no area), everything narrower than :data:`SPECK_FRACTION` of it is dropped, and the characteristic size is the median of what remains. Small components that together hold :data:`SPECK_MAX_AREA_SHARE` of the stained area or more are a second population, not specks, and stay. 5. **Cross-check by distance transform.** Step 3 has one dominant failure mode: a confluent monolayer fuses into a single component, that component touches the border and is dropped, and the estimate is then computed from whatever debris survived — biased **low**, and silently. So the Euclidean distance transform of the (unfilled) foreground is computed as well, its local maxima are taken as one seed per object (two passes: a coarse pass sets the suppression radius for the refined pass), and a watershed on ``-EDT`` splits the fused foreground back into objects whose equivalent diameters are measured the same way.
records.translation: 1. Vad är det som händer? **Flatten.** Denoise med en 1 px Gaussian, sedan subtrahera en kraftigt utjämnad kopia (sigma = max(32, min(H, W) / 4)) för att ta bort belysningsgradienter. Sigma är avsiktligt mycket större än någon rimlig objekt så att platta tar bort vinjettering utan att ta bort objekten - den motsatta kompromissen (en tight rullande boll) krymper vad den försöker mäta. Två. **Avlägsna buller.** Jämför den strukturella amplituden av det tillplattade planet (p99 - p30) mot *pixel-nivån* bullerskalan, mätt som ``1.4826 * MAD(img - gaussian(img, 1))`` på det råa planet. Ett plan för ren buller som är lägre än 1. Ett plan med verkliga objekt poäng i tiotal. Under ``min_snr`` fältet kastas snarare än tröskel, eftersom Otsu returnerar en tröskel även för rent buller, och den resulterande storleken ser giltig. 3. **Threshold och etikett.** Otsu, fylla hål, etikett, släppa komponenter som vidrör bilden kant (trunkerad, så deras storlek är för liten) och komponenter som är absurda (motsvarande diameter under ``min_object_diameter``, eller område över ``max_object_fraction`` av fältet). Storlekar är likvärdiga diametrar, ``2 * sqrt(area / pi)``. 4. **Drop specks, sedan ta median** En texturerad eller punktformig färgning (en mitokondriell cellfärgning, en parasitmarkör) tröskelvärden i ett fåtal hela objekt plus hundratals 4-10 px speck, och en enkel median räknar varje fläck som ett objekt: på spaCR egen testlaboratorium mikroplatta som sätter cellen vid 8 px och patogenen vid 11 px mot 175 px respektive 32 px i de kurerade maskerna, medan kärnan, vars färgning är jämn, kom ut rätt vid 91 px. Så det typiska objektet är först lokaliserad av den färgade ytan den bär (den area viktade medianen, som prickar inte kan röra sig eftersom de håller nästan ingen yta), allt smalare än :data:`SPECK_FRACTION` av det släpps, och den karakteristiska storleken är medianvärdet för vad som återstår. Små komponenter som tillsammans håller :data:`SPECK_MAX_AREA_SHARE` av den färgade ytan eller mer är en andra population, inte prickar, och stannar. 5. **Cross-kontroll med distanstransform.** Steg 3 har ett dominerande felläge: ett konfluent monolager smälter samman till en enda komponent, att komponenten vidrör gränsen och släpps, och uppskattningen beräknas sedan från vad skräp överlevde — partisk **low** och tyst. Så Euclidean avstånd transform av (ofylld) förgrund är beräknas också, dess lokala maxima tas som ett frö per objekt (två passerar: en grov pass sätter dämpningsradien för det raffinerade passet), och en vattendelar på ``-EDT`` delar den sammanslagna förgrunden tillbaka till objekt vars motsvarande diametrar mäts på samma sätt.

records.context: spaCR's other two routes from image to numbers both depend on prior choices. The measured panel in :mod:`spacr.measure` computes a fixed, hand-designed set -- intensity, shape, texture, distances -- so it captures only named properties. The supervised path in :mod:`spacr.deep_spacr` fine-tunes a backbone against annotations, so it captures only annotated classes. A phenotype with no corresponding column or annotation (for example a subtle vacuole mislocalisation) is not detected by either route.
records.label: spacr.embeddings#1
records.source: spaCR's other two routes from image to numbers both depend on prior choices. The measured panel in :mod:`spacr.measure` computes a fixed, hand-designed set -- intensity, shape, texture, distances -- so it captures only named properties. The supervised path in :mod:`spacr.deep_spacr` fine-tunes a backbone against annotations, so it captures only annotated classes. A phenotype with no corresponding column or annotation (for example a subtle vacuole mislocalisation) is not detected by either route.
records.translation: spaCR: s andra två rutter från bild till nummer beror båda på tidigare val. Den uppmätta panelen i :mod:`spacr.measure` beräknar en fast, handdesignad uppsättning -- intensitet, form, textur, avstånd -- så den fångar bara namngivna egenskaper. Den övervakade sökvägen i :mod:`spacr.deep_spacr` finjusterar en ryggrad mot annoteringar, så den tar bara upp annoterade klasser. En fenotyp utan motsvarande kolumn eller annotation (till exempel en subtil vakuol fellokalisering) detekteras inte av någondera rutten.

records.context: Per-image data channel, then concatenate (:data:`CHANNEL_PER_CHANNEL`, the default). Each image data channel is encoded on its own and the vectors are joined. image data channel identity is preserved: dimension 517 belongs to image data channel 2 only, so :mod:`spacr.attribution_columns` can report which stain a hit came from and a reader can drop an image data channel without re-embedding. Costs N forward passes.
records.label: spacr.embeddings#3
records.source: Per-channel, then concatenate (:data:`CHANNEL_PER_CHANNEL`, the default). Each channel is encoded on its own and the vectors are joined. Channel identity is preserved: dimension 517 belongs to channel 2 only, so :mod:`spacr.attribution_columns` can report which stain a hit came from and a reader can drop a channel without re-embedding. Costs N forward passes.
records.translation: Per-image datakanal, sedan konkatenat (:data:`CHANNEL_PER_CHANNEL`, standard). Varje bilddatakanal kodas på egen hand och vektorerna är sammanfogade. bilddatakanalens identitet bevaras: dimension 517 tillhör endast bilddata kanal 2, så :mod:`spacr.attribution_columns` kan rapportera vilken färgning en träff kom från och en läsare kan släppa en bild datakanal utan att lägga in igen. Kostnader N framåt passerar.

records.context: Project to three (:data:`CHANNEL_PROJECT`). One pass over a fixed image data channel-to-RGB mapping. Cheaper, but irreversible: once image data channels are mixed, no downstream column can be attributed to a stain, so a screen cannot tell whether a difference came from the parasite or the host image data channel.
records.label: spacr.embeddings#4
records.source: Project to three (:data:`CHANNEL_PROJECT`). One pass over a fixed channel-to-RGB mapping. Cheaper, but irreversible: once channels are mixed, no downstream column can be attributed to a stain, so a screen cannot tell whether a difference came from the parasite or the host channel.
records.translation: Projektera till tre (:data:`CHANNEL_PROJECT`). Man passerar över en fast bilddatakanal- till- RGB kartläggning. Billigare, men irreversibel: när bilddatakanaler blandas kan ingen kolumn nedströms tillskrivas en färgning, så en screening kan inte avgöra om en skillnad kom från parasiten eller värdbildskanalen.

records.context: Per-image data channel is the default because it keeps stain attribution: an embedding that detects a phenotype without identifying the stain that carries it is of limited use. Projection remains available when the number of forward passes is the limiting cost.
records.label: spacr.embeddings#5
records.source: Per-channel is the default because it keeps stain attribution: an embedding that detects a phenotype without identifying the stain that carries it is of limited use. Projection remains available when the number of forward passes is the limiting cost.
records.translation: Per-image datakanal är standard eftersom det behåller tillskrivningen till färgning: en inbäddning som upptäcker en fenotyp utan att identifiera den färgning som bär den är av begränsad användning. Projektion förblir tillgänglig när antalet framåtpass är den begränsande kostnaden.

It accepts one or more mixed folders/files, detects intensity images and label images, lets callers override every proposed role/object type, builds the canonical ``stack/``, ``masks/`` and ``merged/`` folders, and then delegates all feature extraction and crop generation to :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`.

records.context: This is a merge onto the canonical structured-data names rather than a substitution for them because the canonical tables carry things a foreign table cannot reproduce: every spaCR feature column, and ``cell_id``, the link from a nucleus or pathogen back to the cell that contains it. Replacing the table would drop both, and a parent-child link is not recoverable from what is left. ``conversion_map`` gets the same treatment — merged on the output filename, never replaced — so a project's provenance back to its own original files survives an import into it.
records.label: spacr.foreign#13
records.source: This is a merge onto the canonical keys rather than a substitution for them because the canonical tables carry things a foreign table cannot reproduce: every spaCR feature column, and ``cell_id``, the link from a nucleus or pathogen back to the cell that contains it. Replacing the table would drop both, and a parent-child link is not recoverable from what is left. ``conversion_map`` gets the same treatment — merged on the output filename, never replaced — so a project's provenance back to its own original files survives an import into it.
records.translation: Detta är en sammanfogning till de kanoniska strukturerade datanamnen snarare än en ersättning för dem eftersom de kanonerska tabellerna bär saker som en utländsk tabell inte kan reproducera: varje spaCR egenskapskolumn, och ``cell_id``, länken från en kärna eller patogen tillbaka till cellen som innehåller den. Byte av tabellen skulle släppa båda, och en förälder-barn länk är inte återvinningsbara från vad som finns kvar. ``conversion_map`` får samma behandling — slås samman på utdatafilnamnet, aldrig ersatt — så ett projekts härkomst tillbaka till sina egna ursprungliga filer överlever en import till den.

records.source: **Nothing is proposed onto a spaCR feature name.** Their ``Area`` is not spaCR's ``cell_area``: different segmentation, different definition, different unit. records.translation: **Inget föreslås på en spaCR egenskapsnamn.** Deras ``Area`` är inte spaCR ``cell_area``: olika segmentering, olika definition, olika enhet. Varje egenskapskolumn föreslås vara ``foreign_<name>``. För att skriva en kolumn i spaCR: s namn, redigera målet och passera ``allow_spacr_targets=True`` till :func:`plan_import`.

records.context: Let ``n`` be the number of microplate sample positions and ``G`` the number of guides. For well ``i``, ``y_i`` is the phenotype and ``x_ig`` is guide ``g``'s read fraction. ``Z`` is the ``n x q`` nuisance design: indicator columns for the block (normally ``plateID``) and for each column in ``nuisance_columns`` (normally ``rowID`` and ``columnID``). A rank-deficient ``Z`` raises ``ValueError`` rather than being pseudo-inverted, because a nuisance basis that cannot be inverted is a design question, not a numerical one.
records.label: spacr.guide_permutation.guide_freedman_lane_test#2
records.source: Let ``n`` be the number of wells and ``G`` the number of guides. For well ``i``, ``y_i`` is the phenotype and ``x_ig`` is guide ``g``'s read fraction. ``Z`` is the ``n x q`` nuisance design: indicator columns for the block (normally ``plateID``) and for each column in ``nuisance_columns`` (normally ``rowID`` and ``columnID``). A rank-deficient ``Z`` raises ``ValueError`` rather than being pseudo-inverted, because a nuisance basis that cannot be inverted is a design question, not a numerical one.
records.translation: Låt ``n`` vara antalet mikroplattors provpositioner och ``G`` antalet guider. För brunn ``i`` är ``y_i`` fenotypen och ``x_ig`` är vägledningen ``g`` läsfraktionen. ``Z`` är den ``n x q`` störande designen: indikatorkolumnerna för blocket (normalt ``plateID``) och för varje kolumn i ``nuisance_columns`` (vanligtvis ``rowID`` och ``columnID``). En rank-brist ``Z`` höjer ``ValueError`` snarare än att vara pseudo-inverterad, eftersom en olägenhetsgrund som inte kan inverteras är en designfråga, inte en numerisk fråga.

records.context: No microscope lights a microscope field of view evenly. A lamp profile, vignetting in the objective, a tilted condenser and dirt on the optics together make the same cell measure brighter at the centre of the microscope field of view than at its edge -- routinely 10-40 % between the middle and a corner on a widefield screening experiment. Every intensity feature spaCR writes (``*_mean_intensity``, ``*_percentile_*``, the radial distribution, the texture image data channels that are computed on intensity) therefore carries a **position-dependent bias**, and because objects are not distributed identically over every microplate sample position, that bias does not average out: it survives into the per-microplate sample position aggregate, and from there into classification and regression as an effect that looks entirely real and is entirely an artefact of the optics.
records.label: spacr.illumination#2
records.source: No microscope lights a field of view evenly. A lamp profile, vignetting in the objective, a tilted condenser and dirt on the optics together make the same cell measure brighter at the centre of the field than at its edge -- routinely 10-40 % between the middle and a corner on a widefield screen. Every intensity feature spaCR writes (``*_mean_intensity``, ``*_percentile_*``, the radial distribution, the texture channels that are computed on intensity) therefore carries a **position-dependent bias**, and because objects are not distributed identically over every well, that bias does not average out: it survives into the per-well aggregate, and from there into classification and regression as an effect that looks entirely real and is entirely an artefact of the optics.
records.translation: Ingen mikroskop ljus ett mikroskop synfält jämnt. En lampa profil, vinjettering i objektivet, en lutande kondensor och smuts på optiken tillsammans gör samma cell mäter ljusare i centrum av mikroskopet synfältet än vid dess kant -- rutinmässigt 10-40 % mellan mitten och ett hörn på ett widefield screening experiment. Varje intensitet egenskap spaCR skriver (``*_mean_intensity``, ``*_percentile_*``, radial distribution, textur bilddatakanalerna som beräknas på intensitet) därför bär en **positionsberoende biasitet**, och eftersom objekt inte distribueras identiskt över varje mikroplate provposition, att snedhet inte genomsnitt ut: det överlever i den per mikroplatte provläge, och därifrån till klassificering och regression som en effekt som ser helt verklig och är helt en artefakt av optiken.

records.context: 1. A ``wellID`` that **is** a well address keeps it — :func:`spacr.convert.normalise_well` reads ``a1``, ``A-01``, ``Q01`` (row 17) and ``AA13`` (row 27) alike. 2. Anything else — ``1``, ``well_left``, a positional number — is handed a synthetic id, in ``_natural_key`` order so the same folder always converts the same way. 3. Each distinct source ``plateID`` gets its own ``plate<N>`` token, so well ``A01`` of two source laboratory microplates stays two microplate sample positions.
records.label: spacr.io.convert_separate_files_to_yokogawa#3
records.source: 1. A ``wellID`` that **is** a well address keeps it — :func:`spacr.convert.normalise_well` reads ``a1``, ``A-01``, ``Q01`` (row 17) and ``AA13`` (row 27) alike. 2. Anything else — ``1``, ``well_left``, a positional number — is handed a synthetic id, in ``_natural_key`` order so the same folder always converts the same way. 3. Each distinct source ``plateID`` gets its own ``plate<N>`` token, so well ``A01`` of two source plates stays two wells.
records.translation: 1. Vad är det som händer? A ``wellID`` att **is** en brunn adress håller det — :func:`spacr.convert.normalise_well` läser ``a1``, ``A-01``, ``Q01`` (rad 17) och ``AA13`` (rad 27) lika. Två. Allt annat - ``1``, ``well_left``, ett positionsnummer - lämnas en syntetisk id, i ``_natural_key`` ordning så samma mapp konverterar alltid på samma sätt. 3. Vad är det som händer? Varje distinkt källa ``plateID`` får sin egen ``plate<N>`` token, så brunn ``A01`` av två källa laboratoriemikroplattor stannar två mikroplattor provpositioner.

records.context: The dataset under ``src/<mode>`` is read once and then re-split k ways, so every extracted image region is used for validation exactly once. Folds are class-stratified and, by default, grouped by well so that extracted image regions from the same well stay on one side of the split. Class balancing is applied to the fold's train loader only.
records.label: spacr.io.generate_cv_loaders#1
records.source: The dataset under ``src/<mode>`` is read once and then re-split k ways, so every crop is used for validation exactly once. Folds are class-stratified and, by default, grouped by well so that crops from the same well stay on one side of the split. Class balancing is applied to the fold's train loader only.
records.translation: Datauppsättningen under ``src/<mode>`` läses en gång och sedan återsplittas k- sätt, så varje extraherad bildregion används för validering exakt en gång. Vikningar är klassstratifierade och, som standard, grupperas per brunn så att extraherade bildregioner från samma brunn stannar på ena sidan av split. Klassbalansering tillämpas endast på veckets tåglastare.

records.source: A missing `png_list` means no PNG folder was written, not that there is no data. The objects are still in the measurement table with the same well metadata the class rules select on, so that is read instead -- otherwise a project holding everything it needs reports "0 classes".

Objekten finns fortfarande i mättabellen med samma brunnsmetadata som klassreglerna väljer, så det läses istället - annars är ett projekt som håller allt det behöver rapportera "0 klasser".

records.context: Every index lands in exactly one validation fold, so the k folds partition the dataset. With ``groups`` supplied, a whole group is assigned to a single fold — extracted image regions from the same well never straddle the train/val line — and groups are placed greedily into whichever fold currently leaves the per-class proportions most even, which is how stratification survives grouping.
records.label: spacr.io.make_cv_folds#1
records.source: Every index lands in exactly one validation fold, so the k folds partition the dataset. With ``groups`` supplied, a whole group is assigned to a single fold — crops from the same well never straddle the train/val line — and groups are placed greedily into whichever fold currently leaves the per-class proportions most even, which is how stratification survives grouping.
records.translation: Varje index landar i exakt ett valideringsveck, så k veck partitionerar datasetet. Med ``groups`` levereras, en hel grupp tilldelas till en enda veck - extraherade bildregioner från samma brunn aldrig stratifiera tåg / vallinje - och grupper placeras girigt i vilken veck som för närvarande lämnar de per-klass proportioner mest även, vilket är hur stratifiering överlever gruppering.

records.context: Seed passed to :func:`make_cv_folds` and used to break ties between equally suitable folds. Different seeds can produce different holdouts when several partitions satisfy the constraints. The seed has no effect when the groups permit only one partition.
records.label: spacr.io.make_validation_holdout#5
records.source: Seed passed to :func:`make_cv_folds` and used to break ties between equally suitable folds. Different seeds can produce different holdouts when several partitions satisfy the constraints. The seed has no effect when the groups permit only one partition.
records.translation: Frö gick till :func:`make_cv_folds` och används för att bryta band mellan lika lämpliga veck. Olika frön kan producera olika hållplatser när flera partitioner uppfyller begränsningarna. Fröet har ingen effekt när grupperna bara tillåter en partition.

records.context: The model under a comparison grid: four panels showing four channels of one microscope field of view, or the same microscope field of view at four timepoints, or the same well under four conditions. Panning one pans all of them and zooming one zooms all of them, so a difference between two panels reflects a difference in the *data* rather than a different microscope field of view.
records.label: spacr.layers.CanvasLink#1
records.source: The model under a comparison grid: four panels showing four channels of one field, or the same field at four timepoints, or the same well under four conditions. Panning one pans all of them and zooming one zooms all of them, so a difference between two panels reflects a difference in the *data* rather than a different field of view.
records.translation: Modellen under ett jämförelsegaller: fyra paneler som visar fyra kanaler av ett mikroskopfält, eller samma mikroskopiska synfält vid fyra tidpunkter, eller samma brunn under fyra förhållanden. Panning en panorerar alla av dem och zooma en zoomar dem alla, så en skillnad mellan två paneler återspeglar en skillnad i *data* snarare än ett annat mikroskopfält.

records.context: A labels layer on its own knows that object 17 is object 17. Structured-data names are built by handing a frame to :func:`spacr.selection.object_keys` rather than joining strings here, so this cannot drift from the identity the rest of the codebase agrees on.
records.label: spacr.layers.FieldKey#1
records.source: A labels layer on its own knows that object 17 is object 17. Only the field it came from turns that into ``plate1_A_1_1_17`` — the key the UMAP, the plate view and the annotation grid all already use. Keys are built by handing a frame to :func:`spacr.selection.object_keys` rather than joining strings here, so this cannot drift from the identity the rest of the codebase agrees on.
records.translation: Ett eget etikettlager vet att objekt 17 är objekt 17. Endast mikroskopfältet som det kom från förvandlar det till ``plate1_A_1_1_17`` – det strukturerade datanamnet UMAP, laboratoriets microplatevy och annoteringsfältet som redan används. Strukturerade datanamn byggs genom att lämna en ram till :func:`spacr.selection.object_keys` snarare än att sammanfoga strängar här, så detta kan inte glida från identiteten som resten av kodbasen instämmer i.

records.context: **Every panel uses one world-units-per-pixel scale.** That is the whole difficulty, and it is why this is a class rather than three :meth:`Canvas.covering` calls. Confocal stacks in this codebase are routinely 0.65 µm in xy and 2 µm in z; a side view drawn one pixel per slice is three times too thin, and it does not look wrong — it looks like a slightly flat cell. Nuclear sphericity, colocalisation depth and every 3-D shape feature read off such a picture are wrong by a factor nobody sees. Here the side views are :math:`z_{span}/step` pixels tall, so a 10-slice 2 µm stack is 31 px of a 0.65 µm/px view, not 10.
records.label: spacr.layers.OrthoViews#5
records.source: **Every panel uses one world-units-per-pixel scale.** That is the whole difficulty, and it is why this is a class rather than three :meth:`Canvas.covering` calls. Confocal stacks in this codebase are routinely 0.65 µm in xy and 2 µm in z; a side view drawn one pixel per slice is three times too thin, and it does not look wrong — it looks like a slightly flat cell. Nuclear sphericity, colocalisation depth and every 3-D shape feature read off such a picture are wrong by a factor nobody sees. Here the side views are :math:`z_{span}/step` pixels tall, so a 10-slice 2 µm stack is 31 px of a 0.65 µm/px view, not 10.
records.translation: **Varje panel använder en världsenhet-per-pixel skala.** Det är hela svårigheten, och det är därför detta är en klass snarare än tre :meth:`Canvas.covering` anrop. Konfokal stackar i denna kodbas är rutinmässigt 0.65 µm i xy och 2 µm i z; en sidovy dras en pixel per skiva är tre gånger för tunn, och den ser inte fel - det ser ut som en något platt cell. Kärnsfäricitet, colocalisation djup och varje 3-D form egenskap avläsa av en sådan bild är fel med en faktor som ingen ser. Här sidovyerna är :math:`z_{span}/step` pixlar höga, så en 10-slice 2 µm stack är 31 px av en 0.65 µm/px vy, inte 10.

records.context: Every object is one feature, ROI or annotation, carrying its object type (``cell``, ``nucleus`` ...), its object id and its class; the class defaults to the object type. Each object is traced on its own, so objects that touch stay separate. Outlines follow pixel edges, not pixel centres: a pixel ``(row, col)`` is the square from ``x = col`` to ``col + 1`` and ``y = row`` to ``row + 1``, the convention QuPath and ImageJ both use. A pixel is inside a polygon when its centre is, so a traced outline rasterised back gives the object exactly: no tolerance, holes and several-part objects included. A hole is an interior ring (GeoJSON), a path of a composite ROI (ImageJ) or, since a COCO polygon cannot have one, an RLE segmentation (COCO).
records.label: spacr.mask_io#9
records.source: Every object is one feature, ROI or annotation, carrying its object type (``cell``, ``nucleus`` ...), its object id and its class; the class defaults to the object type. Each object is traced on its own, so objects that touch stay separate. Outlines follow pixel edges, not pixel centres: a pixel ``(row, col)`` is the square from ``x = col`` to ``col + 1`` and ``y = row`` to ``row + 1``, the convention QuPath and ImageJ both use. A pixel is inside a polygon when its centre is, so a traced outline rasterised back gives the object exactly: no tolerance, holes and several-part objects included. A hole is an interior ring (GeoJSON), a path of a composite ROI (ImageJ) or, since a COCO polygon cannot have one, an RLE segmentation (COCO).
records.translation: Varje objekt är en egenskap, ROI eller annotation, som bär sin objekttyp (``cell``, ``nucleus`` ...), dess objekt id och dess klass; klassen förvaler objekttypen. Varje objekt spåras på egen hand, så objekt som touch förblir separat. Outlines följer pixelkanter, inte pixelscentra: en pixell ``(row, col)`` är kvadraten från ``x = col`` till ``col + 1`` och ``y = row`` till ``row + 1``, konventionen QuPath och ImageJ båda använder. En pixeln är inne i en polygon när dess centrum är, så en spårad kontur rasteriserad tillbaka ger objektet exakt: ingen tolerans, hål och flera delar objekt ingår. Ett hål är en inre ring (GeoJSON), en väg av en komposit ROI (ImageJ) eller, eftersom en COCO polygon inte kan ha en, en RLE segmentering (COCO).

records.context: The **Regression** microscope image field opens this module because :func:`perform_regression` is its main entry point: it joins per-microplate sample position image scores to sequencing counts and estimates guide- or gene-level associations for a pooled screen.  The module also contains a separate classical machine-learning workflow, :func:`generate_ml_scores`, which trains a machine-learning classification model on measured single-object features and turns those predictions into the score table a regression can consume.
records.label: spacr.ml#2
records.source: The **Regression** tile opens this module because :func:`perform_regression` is its main entry point: it joins per-well image scores to sequencing counts and estimates guide- or gene-level associations for a pooled screen.  The module also contains a separate classical machine-learning workflow, :func:`generate_ml_scores`, which trains a classifier on measured single-object features and turns those predictions into the score table a regression can consume.
records.translation: Den **Regression** mikroskop bildfältet öppnar denna modul eftersom :func:`perform_regression` är dess huvudsakliga ingångspunkt: den ansluter per mikroplatta prov position poäng för att sekvensera räkningar och skattningar guide- eller gennivå associationer för en poolad screening. Modulen innehåller också en separat klassisk maskininlärning arbetsflöde, :func:`generate_ml_scores`, som tränar en maskin-lärande klassificering modell på uppmätta enkelobjektegenskaper och vänder dessa förutsägelser till poängtabellen en regression kan konsumera.

records.context: A regression processing session is configured with ``paired_data``: ordered score/count CSV pairs whose laboratory microplate and microplate sample position identities agree.  Older ``score_data`` and ``count_data`` lists are migrated positionally, but explicit pairs are safer. Choose the score column with ``dependent_variable`` and provide the relevant control microplate sample positions, laboratory microplate metadata, analysis ``level`` (guide, gene, or both), multiple-testing threshold, and either a supported ``regression_type`` or ``None`` for distribution-based selection.  Family-specific settings are validated rather than silently ignored.  The classical-ML path instead needs one or more ``measurements.db`` files, labelled positive and negative controls or an annotation column, and a model choice such as XGBoost, logistic regression, or random forest.
records.label: spacr.ml#4
records.source: A regression run is configured with ``paired_data``: ordered score/count CSV pairs whose plate and well identities agree.  Older ``score_data`` and ``count_data`` lists are migrated positionally, but explicit pairs are safer. Choose the score column with ``dependent_variable`` and provide the relevant control wells, plate metadata, analysis ``level`` (guide, gene, or both), multiple-testing threshold, and either a supported ``regression_type`` or ``None`` for distribution-based selection.  Family-specific settings are validated rather than silently ignored.  The classical-ML path instead needs one or more ``measurements.db`` files, labelled positive and negative controls or an annotation column, and a model choice such as XGBoost, logistic regression, or random forest.
records.translation: En regressionsbehandlingssession är konfigurerad med ``paired_data``: beställd poäng/antal CSV par vars mikroplattor och mikroplattors provpositionsidentiteter överensstämmer. Äldre ``score_data`` och ``count_data`` listor migreras positionellt, men explicita par är säkrare. Välj poängkolumnen med ``dependent_variable`` och tillhandahålla relevanta kontrollmikroplattors urvalspositioner, laboratoriemetadata för mikroplattor, analys ``level`` (guide, gen eller båda), tröskel för flera tester, och antingen ett stöd för ``regression_type`` eller ``None`` för distributionsbaserat urval. Familjespecifika inställningar valideras snarare än tyst ignoreras. Den klassiska-ML sökvägen behöver istället en eller flera ``measurements.db``-filer, märkta positiva och negativa kontroller eller en annoteringskolumn, och ett modellval som XGBoost, logistisk regression eller slumpmässig skog.

records.context: Regression results go into a new, non-overwriting ``<output root>/results/<analysis kind>[_n]`` directory.  ``results.csv`` is the primary combined table; ``results_grna.csv`` and ``results_gene.csv`` make the fitted levels explicit, and ``results_significant.csv`` records thresholded hits.  The same directory holds summaries, diagnostics, volcano and laboratory microplate figures, optional publication-panel packages, resource measurements, or a detailed failure report.  A requested level with no fitted rows is kept as a header-only CSV so downstream tools can distinguish "tested, no rows" from a missing artifact.  Classical ML writes predictions, feature-importance tables, evaluation results, and a laboratory microplate heatmap beneath ``results``.
records.label: spacr.ml#6
records.source: Regression results go into a new, non-overwriting ``<output root>/results/<analysis kind>[_n]`` directory.  ``results.csv`` is the primary combined table; ``results_grna.csv`` and ``results_gene.csv`` make the fitted levels explicit, and ``results_significant.csv`` records thresholded hits.  The same directory holds summaries, diagnostics, volcano and plate figures, optional publication-panel packages, resource measurements, or a detailed failure report.  A requested level with no fitted rows is kept as a header-only CSV so downstream tools can distinguish "tested, no rows" from a missing artifact.  Classical ML writes predictions, feature-importance tables, evaluation results, and a plate heatmap beneath ``results``.
records.translation: Regressionsresultat går in i en ny katalog som inte skrivs över ``<output root>/results/<analysis kind>[_n]``. ``results.csv`` är den primära kombinerade tabellen; ``results_grna.csv`` och ``results_gene.csv`` gör de monterade nivåerna explicita, och ``results_significant.csv`` registrerar tröskelträffar. Samma katalog innehåller sammanfattningar, diagnostiker, vulkan- och laboratoriemikroplattor, valfria publikationspanelpaket, resursmätningar eller en detaljerad felrapport. En begärd nivå utan monterade rader behålls endast som en rubrik CSV så nedströmsverktyg kan skilja "testade, inga rader" från en saknad artefakt. Klassisk ML skriver förutsägelser, tabeller för egenskapsvikt, utvärderingsresultat och en mikroplatta värmekarta under ``results``.

records.context: ``lasso`` and ``elasticnet`` do not rely on this at all — :data:`NO_P_VALUE_TYPES` routes them to a bootstrap selection frequency instead. ``ridge`` does, because it never sets a coefficient to exactly zero and so has no selection frequency to report (every feature would score 1.0), and a conservative test is a better answer than no test. ``tests/test_regression_orientation.py`` pins the null case, which is where an anticonservative version of this would show.

With only two screen levels, a random screen variance would be estimated from one degree of freedom. records.source: A blockable ``screenID`` supplied by :func:`prepare_formula` remains a fixed effect. With only two screen levels, a random screen variance would be estimated from one degree of freedom. The plate is not nested within the screen because plate position is already represented by the row and column structure. Single-screen data omit the constant screen term to avoid a rank-deficient design.
records.translation: En blockeringsbar ``screenID`` som tillhandahålls av :func:`prepare_formula` förblir en fast effekt. Med endast två screeningnivåer skulle en slumpmässig screeningvarians uppskattas från en grad av frihet. Laboratoriets mikroplatta är inte inbäddad i screeningen eftersom laboratoriets mikroplattors läge redan representeras av rad- och kolumnstrukturen. Data från en enda screening utelämnar den konstanta screeningtermen för att undvika en rang-bristande design.

records.context: The threshold lets a plot with a raw-P axis show the corrected call. A volcano with the adjusted P on its y-axis inherits the step function created by the cumulative minimum in Benjamini-Hochberg. Every correction here is monotone in the raw P within a family, so the called set is a lower set: there is a rank ``k`` such that every test with ``p <= p_(k)`` is called and every test above it is not. One horizontal line at ``-log10(p_(k))`` on the raw-P axis therefore separates the called tests exactly as the correction does.
records.label: spacr.multiple_testing.critical_p_value#1
records.source: The threshold lets a plot with a raw-P axis show the corrected call. Every correction here is monotone in the raw P within a family, so the called set is a lower set: there is a rank ``k`` such that every test with ``p <= p_(k)`` is called and every test above it is not. One horizontal line at ``-log10(p_(k))`` on the raw-P axis therefore separates the called tests exactly as the correction does.
records.translation: Tröskelvärdet låter ett diagram med en rå-P-axel visa den korrigerade anropet. En vulkan med justerad P på sin y-axel ärver den stegfunktion som skapas av det kumulativa minimum i Benjamini-Hochberg. Varje korrigering här är monoton i rå P inom en familj, så den så kallade uppsättningen är en lägre uppsättning: det finns en rank ``k`` sådan att varje test med ``p <= p_(k)`` kallas och varje test ovan är det inte. En horisontell linje på ``-log10(p_(k))`` på rå- P-axeln separerar därför de så kallade testerna exakt som korrigeringen gör.

records.context: **Why there is a cap.** A spaCR object table has 300-600 columns. A MapAnnotation with 400 entries renders in OMERO.web as a 400-row scrolling table in a 300 px panel, which hides the annotations worth showing. So the annotation is a *summary*, capped at ``max_pairs`` (:data:`MAX_MAP_PAIRS` = 50 by default) and ordered so the useful structured-data names are the ones that survive: ``priority`` structured-data names first in the order given, then the row's own order. When anything is cut, the last pair is :data:`TRUNCATION_KEY`, saying how many were dropped and that the full table is the CSV attached under :data:`NS_FILE`. The full table is never *only* in the annotation.

records.translation: **Varför det finns en cap.** A spaCR objekt bord har 300-600 kolumner. records.context: Under :data:`REPLACE` — the default — an annotation whose namespace is *exactly* ``namespace`` is updated in place. Nothing is created, nothing is unlinked and **nothing is deleted**; a re-run therefore leaves one annotation rather than a growing pile, and an annotation in any other namespace (a colleague's, OMERO's own bulk annotations) is never even considered. When more than one already exists — only possible after an :data:`APPEND` run or a concurrent writer — the oldest (lowest id) is updated and the rest are reported in ``duplicates`` rather than removed, because an annotation may be linked elsewhere.
records.label: spacr.omero.plan_annotation#2

Nothing is created, nothing is unlinked and **nothing is deleted**; a re-run therefore leaves one annotation rather than a growing pile, and an annotation in any other namespace (a colleague's, OMERO's own bulk annotations) is never even considered. When more than one already exists — only possible after an :data:`APPEND` run or a concurrent writer — the oldest (lowest id) is updated and the rest are reported in ``duplicates`` rather than removed, because an annotation may be linked elsewhere.
records.translation: Under :data:`REPLACE` — standard — en annotering vars namnrymd är *exactly* ``namespace`` uppdateras på plats. Ingenting skapas, ingenting avlänkas och **ingenting tas bort**; en omkörning lämnar därför en annotering i stället för en växande hög, och en annotering i någon annan namnrymd (en kollegas, OMERO egna bulk annoteringar) är aldrig ens övervägt. När mer än en redan finns — endast möjligt efter en :data:`APPEND` körning eller en samtidig skrivare — den äldsta (lägsta id) uppdateras och resten rapporteras i ``duplicates`` i stället för att tas bort, eftersom en annotering kan vara länkad någon annanstans.

records.context: The phenotype images are 2960x2960 at 20X and the sequencing images are 1480x1480 at 10X, of the same round well (phase A4 of the optical pooled screening experiment workflow). This step produces one transform per phenotype microscope field of view into the sequencing frame, aligned on the nuclear stain. It does not resample either acquisition into the other: the transform is stored and the pixels are left where they were, because resampling would lose information.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype#1
records.source: The phenotype images are 2960x2960 at 20X and the sequencing images are 1480x1480 at 10X, of the same round well (phase A4 of the optical pooled screen pipeline). This step produces one transform per phenotype field into the sequencing frame, aligned on the nuclear stain. It does not resample either acquisition into the other: the transform is stored and the pixels are left where they were, because resampling would lose information.
records.translation: Fenotypen bilder är 2960x2960 vid 20X och sekvensbilderna är 1480x1480 vid 10X, av samma runda brunn (fas A4 av den optiska poolade screening experiment arbetsflödet). Detta steg producerar en transform per fenotyp mikroskop fältet av vy till sekvensering ram, i linje med kärnfärgningen. Det inte återprovdera antingen förvärv i den andra: omvandlingen lagras och pixlarna lämnas där de var, eftersom omsampling skulle förlora information.

records.context: The consensus is therefore used as a seed. This module finds the correspondences the seed implies, re-solves the similarity from those correspondences in closed form, and repeats on the correspondences the improved transform implies. :func:`align_by_triangles` already re-estimates its translation from the matched vertices once the scale and rotation are fixed; here the scale and the rotation are re-solved as well.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype#6
records.source: The consensus is therefore used as a seed. This module finds the correspondences the seed implies, re-solves the similarity from those correspondences in closed form, and repeats on the correspondences the improved transform implies. :func:`align_by_triangles` already re-estimates its translation from the matched vertices once the scale and rotation are fixed; here the scale and the rotation are re-solved as well.
records.translation: Samförståndet används därför som frö. Denna modul finner de korrespondenser fröet innebär, löser upp likheten från dessa brevväxlingar i sluten form, och upprepar på brevväxlingarna den förbättrade omvandlingen innebär. :func:`align_by_triangles` redan omvärderar sin översättning från de matchade hörnen när skalan och rotationen är fast; här skalan samt rotationen åter löses också.

records.context: Up to two seeds are refined (the triangle consensus and, with ``expected_scale``, the fixed-scale pair search), and the refined candidate with more agreeing nuclei is kept. Refinement converges to the basin its seed is in, so refining a single seed would choose the answer before comparing the evidence.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.align_phenotype_to_sbs#12
records.source: Up to two seeds are refined (the triangle consensus and, with ``expected_scale``, the fixed-scale pair search), and the refined candidate with more agreeing nuclei is kept. Refinement converges to the basin its seed is in, so refining a single seed would choose the answer before comparing the evidence.
records.translation: Upp till två frön raffineras (triangeln samförstånd och, med ``expected_scale``, den fasta skalan par sökning), och den förfinade kandidaten med mer överenskomna kärnor hålls. Raffinering konvergerar till bäckenet dess frö är i, så raffinering ett enda frö skulle välja svaret innan jämförelse av bevis.

records.context: Alignment needs points that correspond between two frames, not masks; a smoothed local maximum on a nuclear stain provides them at a fraction of a segmentation's cost. Segmentation happens later (phase B), once, on the composite.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.nuclear_points#7
records.source: Alignment needs points that correspond between two frames, not masks; a smoothed local maximum on a nuclear stain provides them at a fraction of a segmentation's cost. Segmentation happens later (phase B), once, on the composite.
records.translation: Anpassning behöver punkter som motsvarar mellan två ramar, inte masker; en utjämnad lokal maximum på en kärnfärgning ger dem till en bråkdel av en segmentering kostnad. Segmentering sker senare (fas B), en gång, på kompositen.

records.context: The seed may be inaccurate. The triangle consensus is biased by up to 44 % in scale on sparse data, but a bias that large still puts the points near the centre of rotation within a few pixels of the truth, which gives enough correspondences to solve from. The first two rounds match at four and two times ``radius`` before narrowing to ``radius``.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.refine_similarity#7
records.source: The seed may be inaccurate. The triangle consensus is biased by up to 44 % in scale on sparse data, but a bias that large still puts the points near the centre of rotation within a few pixels of the truth, which gives enough correspondences to solve from. The first two rounds match at four and two times ``radius`` before narrowing to ``radius``.
records.translation: Fröet kan vara felaktigt. Triangeln samförstånd är partisk med upp till 44 % i skala på glesa data, men en partiskhet som stora fortfarande sätter punkterna nära rotationens centrum inom några pixlar av sanningen, vilket ger tillräckligt med korrespondens för att lösa från. De första två rundorna matchar på fyra och två gånger ``radius`` innan smalnar till ``radius``.

records.context: The correction is fitted from the data rather than from a calibration file, because it depends on the stain, the filters and the exposure -- which are properties of the run, not of the instrument. For each image data channel, the spots where that image data channel dominates are found, and their mean vector becomes that image data channel's axis; the matrix of those axes, inverted, maps observed intensity back onto base identity.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.compensate_crosstalk#2
records.source: The correction is fitted FROM THE DATA rather than from a calibration file, because it depends on the stain, the filters and the exposure -- which are properties of the run, not of the instrument. For each channel, the spots where that channel dominates are found, and their mean vector becomes that channel's axis; the matrix of those axes, inverted, maps observed intensity back onto base identity.
records.translation: Korrigeringen är monterad från data snarare än från en kalibreringsfil, eftersom det beror på färgningen, filtren och exponeringen -- som är egenskaper hos körningen, inte av instrumentet. För varje bilddatakanal, de fläckar där bilddatakanalen dominerar hittas, och deras medelvektor blir den bilddata kanalens axel; matrisen för dessa axlar, inverterade, kartor observerade intensitet tillbaka till basen identitet.

records.context: A pooled Toxoplasma CRISPR screening experiment has three noisy layers stacked on top of each other — which genotypes landed in which well, how many of a well's cells the microscope saw and how well the machine-learning classification model called them, and how many reads each genotype got out of the amplicon pool. The question a screener has to answer *before* spending the microscope time is "with this library, this many microplate sample positions, this many cells per well and a machine-learning classification model at 0.80/0.12, would I actually find a hit?". That is a statistical detection sensitivity analysis, and it is only answerable by simulation because no layer is analytically tractable once the other two are stacked on it.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate#3
records.source: A pooled Toxoplasma CRISPR screen has three noisy layers stacked on top of each other — which genotypes landed in which well, how many of a well's cells the microscope saw and how well the classifier called them, and how many reads each genotype got out of the amplicon pool. The question a screener has to answer *before* spending the microscope time is "with this library, this many wells, this many cells per well and a classifier at 0.80/0.12, would I actually find a hit?". That is a power analysis, and it is only answerable by simulation because no layer is analytically tractable once the other two are stacked on it.
records.translation: En poolad Toxoplasma CRISPR screening experiment har tre bullriga lager staplas ovanpå varandra – vilka genotyper landade i vilken brunn, hur många av en brunns celler mikroskopet såg och hur väl maskininlärning klassificering modell kallas dem, och hur många läser varje genotyp kom ut ur amplicon poolen. Frågan en screeningforskare måste svara *innan* spendera mikroskopet tid är "med detta bibliotek, så många mikroplate provpositioner, så här många celler per brunn och en maskininlärare klassificering modell på 0.80/0.12, skulle jag faktiskt hitta en träff?". Det är en statistisk detektion känslighet analys, och det är bara svarbart genom simulering eftersom inget lager är analytiskt kan trasualiseras när de andra två staplas på den.

records.context: **Where the under-dispersed case is approximate, and which way.** A binomial has an integer number of trials, so it cannot hit an arbitrary ``(mean, var)`` pair. Given the rounded ``n``, the success probability is set to ``mean / n`` so the **mean is exact** and the realised variance is ``mean * (1 - mean/n)``, the nearest value the family attains — within about ``1/n`` relative of the request. The mean is the one preserved because it is the biologically meaningful quantity (cells per well) and it sets the scale of everything downstream, whereas a variance off by a percent changes only how wide the well-to-well spread is. Rounding ``n`` while keeping ``p = (mean - var) / mean`` — the naive inversion — biases the *mean* instead, by up to half a count, which is a systematic error in every well of a sweep.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.sample_count_mean_variance#8
records.source: **Where the under-dispersed case is approximate, and which way.** A binomial has an integer number of trials, so it cannot hit an arbitrary ``(mean, var)`` pair. Given the rounded ``n``, the success probability is set to ``mean / n`` so the **mean is exact** and the realised variance is ``mean * (1 - mean/n)``, the nearest value the family attains — within about ``1/n`` relative of the request. The mean is the one preserved because it is the biologically meaningful quantity (cells per well) and it sets the scale of everything downstream, whereas a variance off by a percent changes only how wide the well-to-well spread is. Rounding ``n`` while keeping ``p = (mean - var) / mean`` — the naive inversion — biases the *mean* instead, by up to half a count, which is a systematic error in every well of a sweep.
records.translation: **Om det underspridda fallet är ungefärligt och åt vilket håll.** En binomial har ett heltal antal försök, så det kan inte träffa en godtycklig ``(mean, var)`` par. Med tanke på den rundade ``n``, framgångsannolikheten är inställd på att ``mean / n`` och **medelvärde är exakt** och den realiserade variansen är ``mean * (1 - mean/n)``, det närmaste värde familjen uppnår - inom ungefär ``1/n`` Medlet är det som bevaras eftersom det är den biologiskt meningsfulla mängden (celler per brunn) och det sätter skalan av allt nedströms, medan en avvikelse från en procent bara ändrar hur bred spridningen mellan brunnar är. Avrundning ``n`` medan den behålls ``p = (mean - var) / mean`` — Den naiva inversionen — fördomar *medelvärde* istället, med upp till en halv räkning, vilket är ett systematiskt fel i varje brunn av en sopning.

records.context: **Two departures from the R original, both deliberate.** Upstream computes ``n_reads_per_well = round(n_reads_total / nrow(well_data))`` inside a ``group_by(well)``, so ``nrow`` is the *library size*: with 452 genes and ``n_reads_total = 128318`` that is 284 reads per well, against a real screening experiment near 3e4. The parameter is documented as "total reads in the screening experiment" in one vignette and "geometric mean of well reads" in another. This function takes ``n_reads_per_well`` unambiguously and reports ``n_reads_total`` as the derived sum. Second, upstream's guard ``k = min(n_cells_in_well * pcr_factor, n_reads_per_well)`` is computed from ``round(sum(cells) * pcr)`` while the urn is ``round(cells * pcr)`` element-wise; the two differ by rounding and the draw can ask for more balls than the urn holds. The guard here is computed from the urn itself.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.simulate_sequencing_plate#3
records.source: **Two departures from the R original, both deliberate.** Upstream computes ``n_reads_per_well = round(n_reads_total / nrow(well_data))`` inside a ``group_by(well)``, so ``nrow`` is the *library size*: with 452 genes and ``n_reads_total = 128318`` that is 284 reads per well, against a real screen near 3e4. The parameter is documented as "total reads in the screen" in one vignette and "geometric mean of well reads" in another. This function takes ``n_reads_per_well`` unambiguously and reports ``n_reads_total`` as the derived sum. Second, upstream's guard ``k = min(n_cells_in_well * pcr_factor, n_reads_per_well)`` is computed from ``round(sum(cells) * pcr)`` while the urn is ``round(cells * pcr)`` element-wise; the two differ by rounding and the draw can ask for more balls than the urn holds. The guard here is computed from the urn itself.
records.translation: **Två avvikelser från R-originalet, båda avsiktliga.** Uppströms beräknar ``n_reads_per_well = round(n_reads_total / nrow(well_data))`` inuti en ``group_by(well)``, så ``nrow`` är *library storlek*: med 452 gener och ``n_reads_total = 128318`` som är 284 avläser per brunn, mot en verklig screening experiment nära 3e4. Parametern dokumenteras som "totalt avläst i screeningexperimentet" i en vinjett och "geometriskt medelvärde av brunnsavläsningar" i ett annat. Denna funktion tar ``n_reads_per_well`` otvetydigt och rapporterar ``n_reads_total`` som härledd summa. För det andra beräknas uppströmsskyddet ``k = min(n_cells_in_well * pcr_factor, n_reads_per_well)`` från ``round(sum(cells) * pcr)`` medan urnan är ``round(cells * pcr)`` elementvis. De två skiljer sig genom avrundning och dragningen kan be om fler bollar än urnan håller. Vakten här beräknas från urnan själv.

records.context: ``prcfo`` --- ``plate_row_column_field_object`` --- is the canonical per-object identity in this codebase. :func:`spacr.utils.filepaths_to_database` writes it onto every ``png_list`` row, :func:`spacr.io._read_and_merge_data` indexes the merged feature frame by it, and :func:`spacr.ml.generate_ml_scores` already joins annotations onto features with it. Keying the merge on it means the CV and the ML stage write to *the same row*.
records.label: spacr.predictions#8
records.source: ``prcfo`` --- ``plate_row_column_field_object`` --- is the canonical per-object identity in this codebase. :func:`spacr.utils.filepaths_to_database` writes it onto every ``png_list`` row, :func:`spacr.io._read_and_merge_data` indexes the merged feature frame by it, and :func:`spacr.ml.generate_ml_scores` already joins annotations onto features with it. Keying the merge on it means the CV and the ML stage write to *the same row*.
records.translation: ``prcfo`` --- ``plate_row_column_field_object``--- är den kanoniska per-objekt identiteten i denna kodbas. :func:`spacr.utils.filepaths_to_database` skriver den på varje ``png_list`` rad, :func:`spacr.io._read_and_merge_data` indexerar den sammanslagna egenskapsramen med den, och :func:`spacr.ml.generate_ml_scores` ansluter redan annoteringar till egenskaper med den. Att ange sammanfogningen betyder CV och ML-scenen skriv till *samma rad*.

records.context: Each input is swept from its low quantile to its high quantile with everything else held at the reference, and the inputs are ranked by the magnitude of the resulting change. Quantiles rather than min/max because one outlier well would otherwise decide the ranking.

records.source: Each input is swept from its low quantile to its high quantile with everything else held at the reference, and the inputs are ranked by the magnitude of the resulting change. Quantiles rather than min/max because one outlier well would otherwise decide the ranking.
records.translation: Varje inmatning sopas från sin låga kvantil till sin höga kvantil med allt annat som hålls vid referensen, och indata rankas efter omfattningen av den resulterande förändringen. Quantiles snarare än min/max eftersom en avvikande brunn skulle annars bestämma rankningen.

records.context: Spectral unmixing comes first. With ``unmix`` on, a bleed-through matrix is estimated from the single-stain control microplate sample positions ``unmix_controls`` names and every raw microscope field of view is unmixed across all its image data channels before illumination correction, the PSF and the chain; the matrix joins the same record. Measure estimates its own over the measured image data channels and unmixes each microscope field of view before its preprocessing hooks, recording the matrix in the saved processing-session settings and ``measurements/bleed_through.json``.
records.label: spacr.psf_pipeline#3
records.source: Spectral unmixing comes first. With ``unmix`` on, a bleed-through matrix is estimated from the single-stain control wells ``unmix_controls`` names and every raw field is unmixed across all its channels before illumination correction, the PSF and the chain; the matrix joins the same record. Measure estimates its own over the measured channels and unmixes each field before its preprocessing hooks, recording the matrix in the saved run settings and ``measurements/bleed_through.json``.
records.translation: Spektral avblandning kommer först. Med ``unmix`` på, beräknas en genomblödningsmatris från kontrollbrunnarna med en enda färgning som ``unmix_controls`` namnger och varje rå mikroskopfält är oblandat över alla sina bilddatakanaler innan belysningskorrigering, polyesterstapelfibrer och kedjan; matrisen ansluter samma post. Mäta uppskattar sin egen över de uppmätta bilddata kanalerna och avmixar varje mikroskopfält av vy innan dess förbearbetning krokar, registrera matris i sparade bearbetning-session inställningar och ``measurements/bleed_through.json``.

records.context: Extracted image region PNGs are not ordinary images. Anything spaCR wrote before the BGR fix has the first stain in the *blue* image data channel, and a 16-bit single-image data channel extracted image region opened with ``convert('RGB')`` is clipped to solid white by PIL. Both are corrected by :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.load_crop_image`, which is therefore the only loader used here, so a hover preview shows the same colours as the annotation grid.

Both are corrected by :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.load_crop_image`, which is therefore the only loader used here, so a hover preview shows the same colours as the annotation grid.
records.translation: Extraherad bildregion PNGs är inte vanliga bilder. Allt som spaCR skrevs innan BGR-fixen har den första färgningen i bilddatakanalen *blå* och en 16-bitars enkelbildskanal extraherad bildregion som öppnas med ``convert('RGB')`` klipps till fast vit med PIL. Båda korrigeras av :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.load_crop_image`, vilket är den enda laddaren som används här, så en förhandsgranskning av svävaren visar samma färger som noteringsnätet.

records.context: What is not live, and why that was accepted. Every size the font scale pins from Python -- row heights, column widths, icon sizes, tile geometry, all of :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.scaled_px` -- moves only when the stylesheet is rebuilt, and that is the 587 ms number. The choice made: "Text live, spacing on release." Text follows the wheel; the spacing around it catches up in one step when the wheel stops or Z comes up. It is a deliberate compromise, not an oversight, and it is why the settle exists.
records.label: spacr.qt.live_zoom#7
records.source: WHAT IS NOT LIVE, AND WHY THAT WAS ACCEPTED. Every size the font scale pins from Python -- row heights, column widths, icon sizes, tile geometry, all of :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.scaled_px` -- moves only when the stylesheet is rebuilt, and that is the 587 ms number. The choice made: "Text live, spacing on release." Text follows the wheel; the spacing around it catches up in one step when the wheel stops or Z comes up. It is a deliberate compromise, not an oversight, and it is why the settle exists.
records.translation: Vad som inte är live, och varför det accepterades. Varje storlek på teckenskalan pins från Python – radhöjder, kolumnbredder, ikonstorlekar, brickgeometri, alla :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.scaled_px` – rör sig bara när stilmallen byggs om, och det är 587 ms-numret. Valet gjordes: "Text live, avstånd vid utgivning." Text följer hjulet; avståndet runt det fångas upp i ett steg när hjulet stannar eller Z kommer upp. Det är en avsiktlig kompromiss, inte ett förbiseende, och den är anledningen till att uppgörelsen existerar.

records.context: Installed on the QApplication because the gesture has to work on every screen -- a per-screen handler works in some places and not others, which is the complaint that produced 315's warning about application filters. That warning is about COST, so the body is two integer comparisons for an event it does not want, and the wheel branch is not even reached unless Z is down. Measured at 1.2 us per uninteresting event on this machine, which is the Python call itself rather than anything this does inside it. Create the filter that scales the interface while the key is held.
records.label: spacr.qt.live_zoom.LiveZoomFilter#1
