Create the filter that scales the interface while the key is held.
records.translation: Installeras på QApplication eftersom gesten måste fungera på varje skärm – en per skärmhanterare fungerar på vissa ställen och inte på andra, vilket är klagomålet som gav 315 varning om programfilter. Den varningen handlar om KOSTNAD, så kroppen är två heltalsjämförelser för en händelse som den inte vill ha, och hjulgrenen nås inte ens om inte Z är nere. Mäts på 1,2 oss per ointressant händelse på den här maskinen, som är Python kallar sig själv snarare än något som detta gör inuti den. Skapa filtret som skalar gränssnittet medan nyckeln hålls.

records.context: **What it is for.** Giving every object a vector that no label went into. The measured panel says how big a cell is and how bright each stain was; an embedding describes what the cell looks like, in a few hundred numbers a pretrained backbone produces without being told what to look for. It complements the panel rather than replacing it: a phenotype that no measured column captures can still be represented in the vector.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#3
records.source: **What it is for.** Giving every object a vector that no label went into. The measured panel says how big a cell is and how bright each stain was; an embedding describes what the cell looks like, in a few hundred numbers a pretrained backbone produces without being told what to look for. It complements the panel rather than replacing it: a phenotype that no measured column captures can still be represented in the vector.
records.translation: **Vad det är för.** Ge varje objekt en vektor som ingen etikett gick in i. Den uppmätta panelen säger hur stor en cell är och hur ljus varje färgning var; en inbäddning beskriver hur cellen ser ut, i några hundra tal en pretränad ryggrad producerar utan att få veta vad man ska leta efter. Den kompletterar panelen snarare än att ersätta den: en fenotyp som ingen uppmätt kolumn fångar kan fortfarande representeras i vektorn.

records.context: **What to do next.** Treat the columns as a feature source, not as a result. They are consumed exactly as the measured panel is -- a reduction to see whether the objects separate, a regression against the perturbation, a retrieval to find the objects most like one you picked. The screening experiment repeats the corresponding warning under the table: a single dimension is not a phenotype, and these numbers can only be interpreted through an analysis that uses the whole vector.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#6

records.translation: **Vad du ska göra härnäst.** Behandla kolumnerna som en egenskapskälla, inte som ett resultat. De förbrukas exakt som den uppmätta panelen är -- en minskning för att se om objekten separerar, en regression mot perturbationen, en hämtning för att hitta de objekt som mest liknar de du valde. Screeningexperimentet upprepar motsvarande varning under tabellen: en enda dimension är inte en fenotyp, och dessa tal kan bara tolkas genom en analys som använder hela vektorn.

records.context: spaCR measures hundreds of features per object, so instead of plotting one column such as ``cell_area`` by condition, this application view shows which features differ between classes and by how much: every continuous column is scored against a class column and sorted by separation, with the distributions of the top few drawn underneath.

records.translation: spaCR mäter hundratals egenskaper per objekt, så istället för att plotta en kolumn såsom ``cell_area`` enligt villkor, visar denna programvy vilka egenskaper som skiljer sig mellan klasser och hur mycket: varje kontinuerlig kolumn görs mot en klasskolonn och sorteras genom separation, med fördelningen av de översta få dras under.

records.context: Assembles the ranking panel with the Local Data Filter (so a ranking can be restricted to one plate without leaving the application view) and the formula panel (so a derived feature is ranked alongside the measured ones). records.source: Assembles the ranking panel with the Local Data Filter (so a ranking can be restricted to one plate without leaving the screen) and the formula panel (so a derived feature is ranked alongside the measured ones). Rankningen utförs på en bakgrundsenhet genom :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`: fyra hundra egenskaper över tvåhundra tusen objekt är ett slags per egenskap, vilket skulle frysa fönstret om det körs på huvudsökvägen GUI.

records.context: The **Objects** tab is the per-object flags; the **Microplate sample positions** tab is the across-well pass. They are separate tabs rather than one merged view because they answer different questions and routinely disagree: a well shifted as a whole flags almost none of its individual objects and is nevertheless the most extreme point among microplate sample positions. The engine's ``report()`` is shown verbatim in the third tab, caveats included — the share flagged is not interpretable without the sentence saying whether a symmetric fence on skewed data produced it.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.outliers#7
records.source: The **Objects** tab is the per-object flags; the **Wells** tab is the across-well pass. They are separate tabs rather than one merged view because they answer different questions and routinely disagree: a well shifted as a whole flags almost none of its individual objects and is nevertheless the most extreme point among wells. The engine's ``report()`` is shown verbatim in the third tab, caveats included — the share flagged is not interpretable without the sentence saying whether a symmetric fence on skewed data produced it.
records.translation: Fliken **Objects** är per-objekt flaggor; fliken **Microplate provpositioner** är mellan-well pass. De är separata flikar snarare än en sammanslagen vy eftersom de svarar på olika frågor och rutinmässigt inte håller med: en brunn som förskjutits som helhet flaggor nästan ingen av sina enskilda objekt och är ändå den mest extrema punkten bland mikroplate prover positioner. Motorns ``report()`` visas ordagrant i den tredje fliken, grottor ingår – den delade flaggas inte kan tolkas utan meningen säger om ett symmetriskt staket på skev data producerade det.

The application view concerns whether to trust a processing session's output, but it works like the Data-selection boundary Editor and the Feature Explorer beside it: the user picks features and a threshold, and the output is a **column** to filter or data-selection boundary on. records.source: ``SECTION_EXPLORE`` rather than ``SECTION_RESULTS``. The screen concerns whether to trust a run's output, but it works like the Gate Editor and the Feature Explorer beside it: the user picks features and a threshold, and the output is a **column** to filter or gate on. Results & QC holds screens that return a verdict; this one returns flags, and :meth:`~spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model.OutlierResult.filtered` is the only place a row is dropped, and only when it is called explicitly.
records.translation: ``SECTION_EXPLORE`` snarare än ``SECTION_RESULTS``. Programvyn gäller om en processsessions utmatning ska lita på, men den fungerar som editorn för datavalsgräns och egenskapen Explorer bredvid den: användaren plockar egenskaper och en tröskel, och utmatningen är en **kolumn** att filtrera eller datavalsgränsen på. Resultat & QC innehåller programvyer som returnerar en dom; den här returnerar flaggor, och :meth:`~spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model.OutlierResult.filtered` är den enda platsen en rad läggs ner, och endast när den kallas explicit.

What has never existed is the surface where a screener asks the question they actually have, which is not "what is the AUROC of a design with well_abundance_factor_mu = 4.6" but

records.source: The science has been in the tree since the spaCRPower port landed: :mod:`spacr.power_simulate` builds a screen you know the truth for, and :mod:`spacr.power_model` fits the horseshoe-Poisson model to it and scores how well the fit recovered the hits you planted. What has never existed is the surface where a screener asks the question they actually have, which is not "what is the AUROC of a design with well_abundance_factor_mu = 4.6" but
records.translation: Vetenskapen har funnits i trädet sedan spaCRPower-porten landade: :mod:`spacr.power_simulate` bygger ett screeningexperiment som du känner till sanningen för, och :mod:`spacr.power_model` passar hästsko-Poisson-modellen till den och visar hur väl passformen återfick träffarna du planterade. Vad som aldrig har existerat är ytan där en screeningforskare ställer frågan de faktiskt har, vilket inte är "vad är AUROC av en design med well_abundance_factor_mu = 4.6" men

records.context: **Volcano Explorer** is the only publication-figure path in spaCR. Its volcano is a matplotlib render behind a 56-field style that can be saved and reloaded as JSON, every called point labelled, colour or shape driven by an annotation file merged on an inferred structured-data name, arbitrary x/y columns, and a vector re-render at journal size. The panel's own volcano is pyqtgraph and can honour none of it, so the explorer is offered from that plot's own menu as "Publication figure…", seeded with the frame already on application view.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.regression#2
records.source: **Volcano Explorer** is the only publication-figure path in spaCR. Its volcano is a matplotlib render behind a 56-field style that can be saved and reloaded as JSON, every called point labelled, colour or shape driven by an annotation file merged on an inferred key, arbitrary x/y columns, and a vector re-render at journal size. The panel's own volcano is pyqtgraph and can honour none of it, so the explorer is offered from that plot's own menu as "Publication figure…", seeded with the frame already on screen.
records.translation: **Volcano Explorer** är den enda publikationsfigursvägen i spaCR. Vulkanen är en matplotlib-retur bakom en 56-fältsstil som kan sparas och laddas om som JSON, varje så kallad punkt märkt, färg eller form drivs av en annoteringsfil sammanslagen på en inferred strukturerad datanamn, godtyckliga x/y kolumner, och en vektor re-render på tidskriftsstorlek. Panelens egen vulkan är pyqtgraph och kan hedra inget av det, så utforskaren erbjuds från dett diagramens egen meny som "Publication figure…", sådd med ramen redan på programvyn.

records.context: 1. **Directional runaway detection and trimming** — :func:`trim_directional_runaway` measures flood width along scanlines extending from the seed. A sustained abrupt expansion marks a leak, and pixels beyond that position are removed. Detection at this stage enables the following two refinements. 2. **Intensity-constrained reflooding** — :func:`wand_region` performs a binary search for the highest tested tolerance that does not trigger runaway detection. The resulting connected region replaces the straight-line directional cut. 3. **Gradient-based boundary refinement** — :func:`taper_region_to_intensity` applies a watershed to a smoothed intensity gradient within a configurable band, moving the provisional boundary toward a nearby image edge.
records.label: spacr.qt.wand_rescue#3
records.source: 1. **Directional runaway detection and trimming** — :func:`trim_directional_runaway` measures flood width along scanlines extending from the seed. A sustained abrupt expansion marks a leak, and pixels beyond that position are removed. Detection at this stage enables the following two refinements. 2. **Intensity-constrained reflooding** — :func:`wand_region` performs a binary search for the highest tested tolerance that does not trigger runaway detection. The resulting connected region replaces the straight-line directional cut. 3. **Gradient-based boundary refinement** — :func:`taper_region_to_intensity` applies a watershed to a smoothed intensity gradient within a configurable band, moving the provisional boundary toward a nearby image edge.
records.translation: 1. Vad är det för fel på dig? **Directional rymling upptäckt och trimning** – :func:`trim_directional_runaway` mäter översvämningsbredd längs skanlines sträcker sig från fröet. En ihållande abrupt expansion markerar en läcka, och pixlar bortom den positionen avlägsnas. Påvisande i detta skede möjliggör följande två förbättringar. Två. **Intensitetskonstruerad omflooding** – :func:`wand_region` utför en binär sökning efter den högsta testade toleransen som inte utlöser rymningsdetektering. Den sammanhängande regionen ersätter den raka riktningsskärningen. 3. Vad är det som händer? **Gradientbaserad gränsförfining** – :func:`taper_region_to_intensity` applicerar en vattendelare på en jämn intensitetsgradient inom ett konfigurerbart band och flyttar den provisoriska gränsen mot en närliggande bildkant.

records.source: ``Z' = 1 - 3(sd_pos + sd_neg) / |mean_pos - mean_neg|`` — the number a screener actually watches, and the one that says whether a plate could have detected anything at all. Charting it with the same limits and the same rules is the same question one level up: a Z' that slides from 0.7 to 0.3 over a campaign is a screen that stopped working, plate by plate, with no single plate looking wrong.
records.translation: ``Z' = 1 - 3(sd_pos + sd_neg) / |mean_pos - mean_neg|`` – numret en screeningforskare faktiskt tittar på, och den som säger om en platta kunde ha upptäckt något alls. Kartläggning av den med samma gränser och samma regler är samma fråga en nivå upp: en Z' som glider från 0,7 till 0,3 under en kampanj är en screening som slutade fungera, platta för platta, utan en enda platta ser fel.

records.context: This module fits concentration series inside spaCR, so a screener with eight doses and three replicates does not need to export a CSV to another program. A fit always produces numbers, but **the answer is often "the EC50 cannot be determined from this experiment"**, and a plain least-squares fit does not report that. ``curve_fit`` will return four numbers and a covariance matrix for a dilution series that never reached a plateau, for a bell-shaped cytotoxicity curve, and for eight points of pure noise. All three come back looking like an EC50 with a confidence interval.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#1
records.source: This module fits concentration series inside spaCR, so a screener with eight doses and three replicates does not need to export a CSV to another program. A fit always produces numbers, but **the answer is often "the EC50 cannot be determined from this experiment"**, and a plain least-squares fit does not report that. ``curve_fit`` will return four numbers and a covariance matrix for a dilution series that never reached a plateau, for a bell-shaped cytotoxicity curve, and for eight points of pure noise. All three come back looking like an EC50 with a confidence interval.
records.translation: Denna modul passar koncentrationsserien inne i spaCR, så en screeningforskare med åtta doser och tre replikat behöver inte exportera ett CSV till ett annat program. En passform producerar alltid siffror, men **svaret är ofta " EC50 kan inte bestämmas från detta experiment"**, och en vanlig minsta-kvartspassning rapporterar inte att. ``curve_fit`` kommer att returnera fyra tal och en kovariansmatris för en utspädningsserie som aldrig nådde en platå, för en klockformad cytotoxicitetskurva, och för åtta punkter av rent brus. Alla tre kommer tillbaka som en EC50 med ett konfidensintervall.

records.translation: Beräknat på medianvärdena **per koncentration**, inte de råa punkterna. Medianvärdet begränsar påverkan från en avvikande brunn på beslutet om lämplighet.

records.context: A laboratory microplate without an assay window is refused rather than scaled by noise. When a laboratory microplate's two controls do not separate there is no assay window, and dividing by that near-zero difference would turn well-to-well noise into hundreds of percent inhibition and a confident EC50 on a laboratory microplate that measured nothing. Such a laboratory microplate's rows come back with a NaN response and a :class:`PlateReport` saying so.

records.source: A plate without an assay window is refused rather than scaled by noise. When a plate's two controls do not separate there is no assay window, and dividing by that near-zero difference would turn well-to-well noise into hundreds of percent inhibition and a confident EC50 on a plate that measured nothing. Such a plate's rows come back with a NaN response and a :class:`PlateReport` saying so.
records.translation: En laboratoriemikroplatta utan ett analysfönster vägras snarare än skalas av buller. När en laboratoriemikroplattors två kontroller inte separerar finns det inget analysfönster, och genom att dividera med den nära-noll skillnaden skulle brus mellan brunnar förvandlas till hundratals procent hämning och en säker EC50 på en laboratorie mikroplatta som mätte ingenting. En sådan laboratoriemikroplates rader kommer tillbaka med ett NaN svar och ett :class:`PlateReport` säger så.

These arrays are slices of the table taken by condition, so a dot's position within its own group is not its row -- and the negative controls are drawn before the screen, so it is not its position on the plot either. Rows are therefore laid out in one flat sequence up front and carried into each scatter, rather than being inferred from the drawing order.

These arrays are slices of the table taken by condition, so a dot's position within its own group is not its row -- and the negative controls are drawn before the screen, so it is not its position on the plot either. Rows are therefore laid out in one flat sequence up front and carried into each scatter, rather than being inferred from the drawing order.
records.translation: Grupperna har samma radordningsproblem som ett sorterat diagram. Arrayerna är skivor av tabellen tagna efter tillstånd, så en punkts position inom sin egen grupp är inte dess rad -- och de negativa kontrollerna ritas före skärmen, så det är inte heller dess position på figuren. Rader läggs därför ut i en plan sekvens fram och utförs i varje scatter, snarare än att härledas från ritningsordningen.

records.context: σ is a MAD, not a standard deviation: a standard deviation is inflated by exactly the outliers a screen exists to find, so a cut measured from one is pulled outwards by the hits and then fails to call them. The median absolute deviation is not, and ×1.4826 makes it the consistent estimator for a normal -- the same statistic :func:`spacr.figures.panels.control_threshold` measures the effect-size cut from, so the dashed lines here and the lines on the volcano put three sigmas at the same value.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.EffectDistribution#2
records.source: σ is a MAD, not a standard deviation: a standard deviation is inflated by exactly the outliers a screen exists to find, so a cut measured from one is pulled outwards by the hits and then fails to call them. The median absolute deviation is not, and ×1.4826 makes it the consistent estimator for a normal -- the same statistic :func:`spacr.figures.panels.control_threshold` measures the effect-size cut from, so the dashed lines here and the lines on the volcano put three sigmas at the same value.
records.translation: σ är en MAD, inte en standardavvikelse: en standard avvikelse är uppblåst av exakt de avvikelser en screening finns till för att hitta, så ett snitt som mäts från en dras utåt av träffarna och sedan misslyckas med att kalla dem. Medianen absoluta avvikelsen är inte, och ×1.4826 gör det till den konsekventa uppskattningen för en normal -- samma statistik :func:`spacr.figures.panels.control_threshold` mäter effekt-storlek skär från, så de streckade linjerna här och linjerna på vulkanen satte tre sigmas till samma värde.

records.context: The reason is the tested family, not the axis: on the TSG101 screen σ (MAD) is 0.229228 over the tested family and 0.229036 with the intercept added, a difference of 0.08%. Dropping it does not visibly move this picture; it restricts the picture to the 1,212 coefficients the q-values describe, which is the same family :func:`spacr.figures.panels.effect_distribution` draws and the same one the effect-size cut is measured from.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.EffectDistribution.set_effects#5
records.source: The reason is the tested family, not the axis: on the TSG101 screen σ (MAD) is 0.229228 over the tested family and 0.229036 with the intercept added, a difference of 0.08%. Dropping it does not visibly move this picture; it restricts the picture to the 1,212 coefficients the q-values describe, which is the same family :func:`spacr.figures.panels.effect_distribution` draws and the same one the effect-size cut is measured from.
records.translation: Orsaken är den testade familjen, inte axeln: i TSG101-screeningen σ (MAD) är 0,229228 över den testade gruppen och 0,229036 med snapton tillsatt, en skillnad på 0,08 %. Att tappa den flyttar inte synligt denna bild; den begränsar bilden till de 1,212 koefficienter som q-värdena beskriver, vilket är samma familj :func:`spacr.figures.panels.effect_distribution` ritar och samma som effekt-storleksskärningen mäts från.

records.context: A click travels: the dot announces its structured-data name, the table selects that row, and every other plot then marks it. records.source: A click travels: the dot announces its key, the table selects that row, and every other plot then marks it. The plots that only received the key know only the key, so they do not overwrite the clicked plot's report.
records.translation: Ett klick reser: pricken tillkännager sitt strukturerade datanamn, tabellen väljer den raden, och varje annan diagram markerar den. records.context: Why this is not ``grab()``. A live plot on a stacked page the user has never reported as an error has never been through a layout pass, so its size is whatever its parent last guessed. Measured on the real regression screen, the volcano inside the collapsed gene splitter of an unshown page: ``volcano.size()`` is 100x9 and ``grab()`` returns a 100x9 pixmap of ONE colour. That is the "blank box with a caption under it" that got the live tile deleted from the figure grid instead of fixed.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.FastPlot.snapshot#3
records.source: WHY THIS IS NOT ``grab()``. A live plot on a stacked page the user has never raised has never been through a layout pass, so its size is whatever its parent last guessed. Measured on the real regression screen, the volcano inside the collapsed gene splitter of an unshown page: ``volcano.size()`` is 100x9 and ``grab()`` returns a 100x9 pixmap of ONE colour. That is the "blank box with a caption under it" that got the live tile deleted from the figure grid instead of fixed.
records.translation: Varför detta inte är ``grab()``. En levande plott på en staplad sida användaren aldrig har rapporterat som ett fel har aldrig gått igenom ett layoutpass, så dess storlek är vad dess förälder senast gissat. Mätt på den verkliga regressionsskärmen, vulkanen inuti den kollapsade gensplittern på en ovisad sida: ``volcano.size()`` är 100x9 och ``grab()`` returnerar en 100x9, pixmap av EN färg. Det är "blank box med en bildtext under den" som fick den levande brickan bort från figuren rutnätet istället för fast.

records.context: AUC represents the probability that a randomly selected object from one class has a higher value than a randomly selected object from the other class. It detects stochastic ordering but can miss distribution-shape differences. For example, classes with the same centre but different spread can have an AUC of 0.5 despite differing distributions. The Kolmogorov–Smirnov (KS) statistic is therefore computed for every feature. A high KS statistic combined with AUC near 0.5 sets :attr:`FeatureScore.is_shape_not_shift`.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.feature_rank#2
records.source: AUC represents the probability that a randomly selected object from one class has a higher value than a randomly selected object from the other class. It detects stochastic ordering but can miss distribution-shape differences. For example, classes with the same centre but different spread can have an AUC of 0.5 despite differing distributions. The Kolmogorov–Smirnov (KS) statistic is therefore computed for every feature. A high KS statistic combined with AUC near 0.5 sets :attr:`FeatureScore.is_shape_not_shift`.
records.translation: AUC representerar sannolikheten att ett slumpmässigt valt objekt från en klass har ett högre värde än ett slumpmässigt utvalt objekt från den andra klassen. Det detekterar stokastisk beställning men kan missa skillnader i fördelningsform. Till exempel kan klasser med samma centrum men olika spridning ha ett AUC på 0,5 trots olika distributioner. Kolmogorov–Smirnov (KS) statistik beräknas därför för varje egenskap. En hög KS statistik kombinerat med AUC nära 0,5 uppsättningar :attr:`FeatureScore.is_shape_not_shift`.

records.context: **This uses a different rule from** ``column_kinds() == CONTINUOUS``. :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.data_filter_panel.classify_columns` treats a numeric column with twelve or fewer distinct values as a *category*. That rule is useful for choosing a slider or a list of selectable values. Feature ranking has a different goal: discrete values remain useful. Counts from 0 to 8 remain valid ranking features. The feature named ``pathogen_count`` is one example. A separation statistic works with a discrete count.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.feature_rank.candidate_features#1
records.source: **Not** ``column_kinds() == CONTINUOUS``, and the difference matters. :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.data_filter_panel.classify_columns` calls a numeric column with twelve or fewer distinct values a *category*, which is the right rule for deciding whether to offer a slider or a tick list — and the wrong one here, because ``pathogen_count`` runs 0–8 and is exactly the kind of feature a ranking exists to surface. A separation statistic is perfectly happy on a discrete count.
records.translation: **Detta använder en annan regel än** ``column_kinds() == CONTINUOUS``. :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.data_filter_panel.classify_columns` behandlar en numerisk kolumn med tolv eller färre olika värden som en *kategori*. Den regeln är användbar för att välja ett skjutreglage eller en lista med valbara värden. Feature ranking har ett annat mål: diskreta värden förblir användbara. Antal från 0 till 8 är giltiga egenskaper att rangordna. Egenskapen ``pathogen_count`` är ett exempel. En separationsstatistik fungerar med ett diskret antal.

records.context: The figures themselves are files in the processing session's own results folder, recorded by the sections that name that folder; copying seventeen PNGs in here would be a second copy of something the processing session already has. What dies with the process is the arrangement -- the tile size the user settled on and which sections they folded away -- and a sweep of sixty trials is unusable if that resets.

records.translation: Siffrorna själva är filer i bearbetningssessionens egen resultatmapp, inspelade av sektionerna som namnger den mappen; att kopiera sjutton PNGs här inne skulle vara en andra kopia av något som behandlingssessionen redan har. Vad som dör med processen är arrangemanget – brickstorleken användaren bosatte sig på och vilka sektioner de vikt bort – och en svepning av sextio försök är oanvändbar om det återställs.

records.context: Restyling from a grid tile has to redraw that tile. Without this the edit lands on the matplotlib object, the picture the grid is built from stays as it was, and the user sees a menu that appears to do nothing -- so they do it again, and again.

records.context: For a redraw that cannot happen in place. `create_grouped_plot` builds its own Figure -- spacrGraph makes one and draws into it -- so "show this data as a violin instead" produces a NEW object, and everything holding the old one (this work list, the grid tile, the thumbnail) has to be pointed at the new one together or the menu looks broken while the tile keeps the old picture.

records.source: For a redraw that cannot happen in place. `create_grouped_plot` builds its own Figure -- spacrGraph makes one and draws into it -- so "show this data as a violin instead" produces a NEW object, and everything holding the old one (this queue, the grid tile, the thumbnail) has to be pointed at the new one together or the menu looks broken while the tile keeps the old picture.
records.translation: För en omdragning som inte kan ske på plats. `create_grouped_plot` bygger sin egen Figur -- spacrGraph gör en och drar in i den -- så "visa denna data som en fiol istället" producerar ett NYT objekt, och allt som håller den gamla (den här arbetslistan, rutnätsbrickan, miniatyrbilden) måste pekas på den nya tillsammans eller menyn ser trasig ut medan brickan behåller den gamla bilden.

records.context: Nowhere, by itself. The panel emits :attr:`FormulaPanel.formulas_changed` and the host re-hands the computed frame to whatever it is driving — the trellis, the data-selection boundary editor, the feature explorer, the Local Data Filter. No other integration is needed: a computed column is an ordinary column from the moment it exists, classified by the same :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.data_filter_panel.classify_columns` rule as a measured one, so it appears in the column well, in the filter picker and in the export without any of them being told about formulas.

records.context: The offered remedy is a **log10 transform**, :data:`TRANSFORM_LOG10`, which turns a lognormal into a Gaussian and makes the fence mean what it appears to mean. It is **never implicit**: a transform silently applied would change what ``outlier_score`` is in units of without the user asking. And it **refuses** rather than fudges on non-positive values — ``log10`` of a zero ``pathogen_area`` is ``-inf``, and an implicit ``+1`` or a dropped row would be an invented measurement or a self-selected population. The refusal names the feature and the count.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#14
records.source: The offered remedy is a **log10 transform**, :data:`TRANSFORM_LOG10`, which turns a lognormal into a Gaussian and makes the fence mean what it appears to mean. It is **never implicit**: a transform silently applied would change what ``outlier_score`` is in units of without the user asking. And it **refuses** rather than fudges on non-positive values — ``log10`` of a zero ``pathogen_area`` is ``-inf``, and an implicit ``+1`` or a dropped row would be an invented measurement or a self-selected population. The refusal names the feature and the count.
records.translation: Den erbjudna åtgärden är en **log10 transform**, :data:`TRANSFORM_LOG10`, som förvandlar en lognormal till en Gaussian och gör stängslet betyder vad det verkar betyda. Det är **never implicit**: en transform tyst tillämpad skulle ändra vad ``outlier_score`` är i enheter av utan användaren frågar. Och det **refuses** snarare än fudges på icke-positiva värden - ``log10`` av en noll ``pathogen_area`` är ``-inf``, och en implicit ``+1`` eller en tappade rad skulle vara en uppfunnen mätning eller en själv utvald befolkning. Vägran namn egenskapen och räkningen.

records.context: **MCD is affine-equivariant.** Rescale ``area`` from px^2 to um^2, or rotate to any linear combination of the features, and the fitted centre and covariance transform with it: every distance, and so every flag, is unchanged. This is the same invariance argument :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model` makes for standardising before a PCA, and it is why no scaling option is needed here — the metric *is* the covariance. A tree ensemble splits on raw coordinates and is not equivariant; its answer depends on the units.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#21
records.source: **MCD is affine-equivariant.** Rescale ``area`` from px^2 to um^2, or rotate to any linear combination of the features, and the fitted centre and covariance transform with it: every distance, and so every flag, is unchanged. This is the same invariance argument :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model` makes for standardising before a PCA, and it is why no scaling option is needed here — the metric *is* the covariance. A tree ensemble splits on raw coordinates and is not equivariant; its answer depends on the units.
records.translation: **MCD är affineekvivariant.** Skala ``area`` från px^2 till um^2, eller rotera till någon linjär kombination av egenskaperna, och den monterade centrum och covariansen omvandla med den: varje avstånd, och så varje flagga, är oförändrad. Detta är samma invariance argument:mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model` gör för standardisering före en PCA, och det är därför ingen skalning alternativ behövs här - metrisk *är* kovariansen. En träd ensemble delas på råa koordinater och är inte likvariant; dess svar beror på enheterna.

records.context: Take 60 objects per well, a feature whose within-well spread is sigma, and a well whose whole population is shifted by 0.9 sigma. The **object** rule at k = 3.5 asks each object to exceed 3.5 sigma; a 0.9 sigma shift moves that requirement to 2.6 sigma, which about one object in 200 clears — so the bad well contributes a fraction of one extra flagged object and disappears into the ordinary tail. The **well** rule compares well *medians*, whose sampling spread is only ``1.2533 * sigma / sqrt(60) = 0.16 sigma``; the same shift is then 5.6 robust SDs and the well is unmistakable. The two tests have wildly different power against the same defect, which is why both are run and both are reported.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#28
records.source: Take 60 objects per well, a feature whose within-well spread is sigma, and a well whose whole population is shifted by 0.9 sigma. The **object** rule at k = 3.5 asks each object to exceed 3.5 sigma; a 0.9 sigma shift moves that requirement to 2.6 sigma, which about one object in 200 clears — so the bad well contributes a fraction of one extra flagged object and disappears into the ordinary tail. The **well** rule compares well *medians*, whose sampling spread is only ``1.2533 * sigma / sqrt(60) = 0.16 sigma``; the same shift is then 5.6 robust SDs and the well is unmistakable. The two tests have wildly different power against the same defect, which is why both are run and both are reported.
records.translation: Ta 60 objekt per brunn, en egenskap vars inre brunn sprids sigma, och en brunn vars hela befolkning flyttas med 0,9 sigma. **object** regel vid k = 3.5 ber varje objekt att överstiga 3,5 sigma; en 0,9 sigma skift flyttar detta krav till 2,6 sigma, som ungefär ett objekt i 200 rensar — så den dåliga brunnen bidrar en bråkdel av en extra flaggat objekt och försvinner i den vanliga svansen. **well** regeln jämför brunnars *medianer*, vars provtagning sprids är bara ``1.2533 * sigma / sqrt(60) = 0.16 sigma``, samma skift är då 5,6 robusta SD och brunnen är omisskännlig. De två testerna har helt olika effekt mot samma defekt, vilket är varför både körs och båda rapporteras.

records.context: The well pass reduces each well to a robust summary — the **median** of each feature over the well's objects, plus ``n`` — and then runs *the same* rule (:data:`METHOD_MAD`, :data:`METHOD_IQR` or :data:`METHOD_MAHALANOBIS`) across microplate sample positions. The median rather than the mean for the same reason as everywhere else here: a single blown-up object must not become a bad well.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#30
records.source: The well pass reduces each well to a robust summary — the **median** of each feature over the well's objects, plus ``n`` — and then runs *the same* rule (:data:`METHOD_MAD`, :data:`METHOD_IQR` or :data:`METHOD_MAHALANOBIS`) across wells. The median rather than the mean for the same reason as everywhere else here: a single blown-up object must not become a bad well.
records.translation: Brunnspasset reducerar varje brunn till en robust sammanfattning – **median** för varje egenskap över brunnens objekt, plus ``n`` – och kör sedan *samma* regel (:data:`METHOD_MAD`, :data:`METHOD_IQR` eller :data:`METHOD_MAHALANOBIS`) över mikroplattors provpositioner. Medianen snarare än medelvärdet av samma orsak som överallt här: ett enda sprängt föremål får inte bli en dålig brunn.

records.context: **A well is not scored on three objects.** Below :data:`DEFAULT_MIN_WELL_OBJECTS` objects the median is too noisy for a comparison across microplate sample positions to mean anything, so the well appears in the well frame with ``well_scored = False`` and a reason saying how many objects it had. It is **never silently dropped and never quietly scored** — a low-n well excluded without a word is how an empty well becomes an unremarkable row.

records.translation: **En brunn görs inte på tre objekt.** Under :data:`DEFAULT_MIN_WELL_OBJECTS` objekt är medianen för bullriga för en jämförelse över mikroplate provpositioner för att betyda något, så brunnen visas i brunnsramen med ``well_scored = False`` och en anledning som säger hur många objekt den hade. Det är **aldrig tyst tappade och aldrig tyst gjorde** – en brunn med lågt n utesluten utan ett ord är hur en tom brunn blir en omärkbar rad.

records.context: spaCR measures hundreds of features per object. A PCA shows in one picture which measurements separate two populations, because the loadings say which measurements carry the separation.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#1
records.source: spaCR measures hundreds of features per object. A PCA shows in one picture which measurements separate two populations, because the loadings say which measurements carry the separation.
records.translation: spaCR mäter hundratals egenskaper per objekt. A PCA visar på en bild vilka mätningar som skiljer två populationer åt, eftersom belastningarna säger vilka mätningarna bär separationen.

records.context: On this kind of table, three decisions determine whether a PCA plot is meaningful, so all three are made here explicitly and reported back to the user with every result.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#2
records.source: On this kind of table, three decisions determine whether a PCA plot is meaningful, so all three are made here explicitly and reported back to the user with every result.
records.translation: På denna typ av tabell, tre beslut avgör om ett PCA-diagram är meningsfull, så alla tre görs här explicit och rapporteras tillbaka till användaren med varje resultat.

records.context: Standardising each feature to mean 0 and sample SD 1 (a *correlation* PCA) makes the result invariant to any per-feature linear rescaling, which is the only defensible default when the columns have no common unit.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#6
records.source: Standardising each feature to mean 0 and sample SD 1 (a *correlation* PCA) makes the result invariant to any per-feature linear rescaling, which is the only defensible default when the columns have no common unit.
records.translation: Om varje egenskap standardiseras till medelvärdet 0 och prov SD 1 (a *korrelation* PCA) blir resultatet varierande till varje linjär skalning per egenskap, vilket är den enda försvarbara standarden när kolumnerna inte har någon gemensam enhet.

records.context: It is not free, and the cost is stated rather than hidden: equal weight means forty near-duplicate Zernike moments outvote one carefully chosen intensity ratio, and a feature that is pure noise gets the same unit of variance as a feature that is pure signal. :data:`SCALE_NONE` is there for the case where the user has already put the features in a common unit and *wants* the big ones to dominate.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#7
records.source: It is not free, and the cost is stated rather than hidden: equal weight means forty near-duplicate Zernike moments outvote one carefully chosen intensity ratio, and a feature that is pure noise gets the same unit of variance as a feature that is pure signal. :data:`SCALE_NONE` is there for the case where the user has already put the features in a common unit and *wants* the big ones to dominate.
records.translation: Det är inte gratis, och kostnaden anges snarare än dold: lika vikt betyder fyrtio nära duplicera Zernike ögonblick överträffar en noga vald intensitet förhållande, och en egenskap som är ren buller får samma enhet varians som en egenskap som är ren signal. :data:`SCALE_NONE` finns där för fallet där användaren redan har lagt egenskaperna i en gemensam enhet och *vill* de stora att dominera.

records.context: Dropping rows instead is not neutral either: complete-case analysis over a feature set containing one ``pathogen_*`` column silently deletes every uninfected cell, so the result is *the PCA of the infected cells* presented as the PCA of the cells.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#11
records.source: Dropping rows instead is not neutral either: complete-case analysis over a feature set containing one ``pathogen_*`` column silently deletes every uninfected cell, so the result is *the PCA of the infected cells* presented as the PCA of the cells.
records.translation: Att istället släppa rader är inte heller neutralt: fullständig analys av en egenskapsuppsättning som innehåller en kolumn ``pathogen_*`` tar tyst bort varje icke-infekterad cell, så resultatet är *PCA av de infekterade cellerna* som presenteras som PCA av cellerna.

records.context: **Infinities are missing under every policy.** Ratio features produce ±inf from a zero denominator, an inf survives ``dropna``, and one of them destroys the scaling and therefore every component. They become NaN before the policy runs and are counted separately in :attr:`PCAResult.n_infinite`.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#18
records.source: **Infinities are missing under every policy.** Ratio features produce ±inf from a zero denominator, an inf survives ``dropna``, and one of them destroys the scaling and therefore every component. They become NaN before the policy runs and are counted separately in :attr:`PCAResult.n_infinite`.
records.translation: **Infiniteter saknas under varje policy.** Ratioegenskaper producerar ±inf från en noll nämnare, en inf överlever ``dropna``, och en av dem förstör skalningen och därmed varje komponent. De blir NaN innan policyn körs och räknas separat i:attr:`PCAResult.n_infinite`.

records.context: **Perfectly collinear** columns are a different problem and get a different answer: they are *kept*, because the feature list is the user's statement of what they care about and picking which of ``area`` and ``area_um2`` to discard is not this module's call. What is refused is inventing components out of the redundancy. The numerical rank is computed from the singular values and no more than ``rank`` components are ever returned, so a table of 12 features spanning 9 real directions yields 9 components, not 12 — the last three would have ~0 explained variance and a direction chosen by floating-point noise. Groups of features that are perfectly correlated are also detected and reported, since a duplicated feature silently doubles its own weight in a correlation PCA.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#21
records.source: **Perfectly collinear** columns are a different problem and get a different answer: they are *kept*, because the feature list is the user's statement of what they care about and picking which of ``area`` and ``area_um2`` to discard is not this module's call. What is refused is inventing components out of the redundancy. The numerical rank is computed from the singular values and no more than ``rank`` components are ever returned, so a table of 12 features spanning 9 real directions yields 9 components, not 12 — the last three would have ~0 explained variance and a direction chosen by floating-point noise. Groups of features that are perfectly correlated are also detected and reported, since a duplicated feature silently doubles its own weight in a correlation PCA.
records.translation: **Perfekt collinear** kolumner är ett annat problem och få ett annorlunda svar: De är *keept*, eftersom egenskapslistan är användarens uttalande om vad de bryr sig om och väljer vilken av ``area`` och ``area_um2`` att kasta är inte modulens anrop. Vad som vägras är uppfinna komponenter ur redundansen. Den numeriska rank beräknas från de singular värden och inte mer än ``rank`` komponenter någonsin returneras, Så en tabell med 12 egenskaper som sträcker sig över 9 verkliga riktningar ger 9 komponenter, inte 12 — de tre sista skulle ha ~0 förklarade varians och en riktning som valts genom flyttal-punktsbuller. Grupper av egenskaper som är fullständigt korrelerade upptäcks och rapporteras också, eftersom en dubblerad egenskap tyst fördubblar sin egen vikt i en korrelation PCA.

records.context: :attr:`PCAResult.explained_variance_ratio` is over the **total variance of the analysed matrix**, so it sums to 1 across all ``rank`` components rather than across the ones that were kept. Alongside it, every result carries how much of the original table it is actually about (:attr:`PCAResult.n_rows_in` versus ``len(result)``, :attr:`PCAResult.n_features_in` versus its features): "PC1 explains 71%" means something different when the matrix is three features and 8% of the objects.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#23
records.source: :attr:`PCAResult.explained_variance_ratio` is over the **total variance of the analysed matrix**, so it sums to 1 across all ``rank`` components rather than across the ones that were kept. Alongside it, every result carries how much of the original table it is actually about (:attr:`PCAResult.n_rows_in` versus ``len(result)``, :attr:`PCAResult.n_features_in` versus its features): "PC1 explains 71%" means something different when the matrix is three features and 8% of the objects.
records.translation: :attr:`PCAResult.explained_variance_ratio` är över **total variation av den analyserade matrisen**, så det är en summa över alla ``rank`` komponenter snarare än tvärs över de som hölls. Vid sidan av det, varje resultat bär hur mycket av den ursprungliga tabellen det faktiskt handlar om (:attr:`PCAResult.n_rows_in` jämfört med ``len(result)``, :attr:`PCAResult.n_features_in` jämfört med dess egenskaper): "PC1 förklarar 71%" betyder något annorlunda när matrisen är tre egenskaper och 8% av objekten.

records.context: The most common way a PCA of morphology features misleads is that **PC1 is just size**. When every feature loads with the same sign, PC1 is a general-magnitude axis — big objects at one end, small at the other — which is usually a fact about segmentation rather than biology. :meth:`PCAResult.is_size_like` detects it from the loading signs and :meth:`PCAResult.headline` says it in words, unprompted.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#24
records.source: The most common way a PCA of morphology features misleads is that **PC1 is just size**. When every feature loads with the same sign, PC1 is a general-magnitude axis — big objects at one end, small at the other — which is usually a fact about segmentation rather than biology. :meth:`PCAResult.is_size_like` detects it from the loading signs and :meth:`PCAResult.headline` says it in words, unprompted.
records.translation: Det vanligaste sättet som en PCA av morfologiska egenskaper vilseleder är att **PC1 bara är storlek**. När varje egenskap lastar med samma tecken, är PC1 en allmän-magnitud axel – stora objekt i ena änden, liten i den andra – vilket vanligtvis är ett faktum om segmentering snarare än biologi. :meth:`PCAResult.is_size_like` upptäcker det från lastskyltarna och :meth:`PCAResult.headline` säger det med ord, utan prompted.

records.source: ``(len(features), k)`` Pearson r between each feature and each component score. This is what the biplot arrows are: unlike a unit-norm loading, an r is a number with a meaning on its own, and for a standardised PCA the squared row sums are each feature's communality.
records.translation: ``(len(features), k)`` Pearson r mellan varje egenskap och varje komponent poäng. Detta är vad biplot pilar är: till skillnad från en enhet-norm laddning, en r är ett tal med en mening på egen hand, och för en standardiserad PCA kvadrat rad summor är varje egenskaps gemensamma.

records.context: features that are perfectly correlated with each other. Kept in the analysis, reported because each such group weighs as many times as it has members.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult#19
records.source: features that are perfectly correlated with each other. Kept in the analysis, reported because each such group weighs as many times as it has members.
records.translation: egenskaper som är perfekt korrelerade med varandra. Hållt i analysen, rapporteras eftersom varje sådan grupp väger lika många gånger som den har medlemmar.

records.context: Near-collinear features leave a numerically full-rank matrix whose last directions are floating-point residue: the solver returns *a* direction because it must, not because the data has one. A component under :data:`DEGENERATE_RATIO` of the total variance is reported with that said, so nobody reads a loading pattern out of rounding error.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.is_degenerate#1
records.source: Near-collinear features leave a numerically full-rank matrix whose last directions are floating-point residue: the solver returns *a* direction because it must, not because the data has one. A component under :data:`DEGENERATE_RATIO` of the total variance is reported with that said, so nobody reads a loading pattern out of rounding error.
records.translation: Nära-kollinjära egenskaper lämnar en numeriskt full-rank matris vars sista riktningar är flyttal-punkt rest: lösaren returnerar *a* riktning eftersom det måste, inte eftersom data har en. En komponent under :data:`DEGENERATE_RATIO` av den totala variansen rapporteras med det nämnda, så ingen läser en laddning mönster av avrundning fel.

records.context: Every feature loading with the same sign is the classic "size" factor of morphometrics: one end big objects, the other end small ones. It is real, it is usually PC1, and it is usually a statement about segmentation and focus rather than about biology — so it is detected and said out loud rather than left for the reader to notice.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.is_size_like#1
records.source: Every feature loading with the same sign is the classic "size" factor of morphometrics: one end big objects, the other end small ones. It is real, it is usually PC1, and it is usually a statement about segmentation and focus rather than about biology — so it is detected and said out loud rather than left for the reader to notice.
records.translation: Varje egenskap som laddas med samma tecken är den klassiska faktorn "size" morphometric: ena änden stora objekt, den andra änden små. Det är verkligt, det är oftast PC1, och det är vanligtvis ett uttalande om segmentering och fokus snarare än om biologi – så det upptäcks och sägs högt snarare än lämnas till läsaren att märka.

records.context: Two guards prevent false detections. It needs three features, because with two "same sign" is a coin flip. And it needs the loading spread over more than one of them: a component that is a *single* feature trivially agrees with itself about sign, and calling that a size axis would be a statement about arithmetic rather than about the objects.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.is_size_like#2
records.source: Two guards prevent false detections. It needs three features, because with two "same sign" is a coin flip. And it needs the loading spread over more than one of them: a component that is a *single* feature trivially agrees with itself about sign, and calling that a size axis would be a statement about arithmetic rather than about the objects.
records.translation: Två vakter förhindrar falska upptäckter. Den behöver tre egenskaper, eftersom med två "same sign" är en myntflip. Och den behöver laddningen spridas över mer än en av dem: en komponent som är en *single* egenskap trivialt instämmer med sig själv om tecken, och kallar att en storleksaxel skulle vara ett uttalande om aritmetisk snarare än om objekten.

records.source: Ranked by ``r_x² + r_y²`` — how much of the feature is visible in this plane at all. Drawing the other four hundred arrows would say nothing except that the figure is full; drawing the *longest* ones is the standard choice because a short arrow means "this feature points somewhere you are not looking", not "this feature does not matter".

records.context: :mod:`spacr.power_simulate` and :mod:`spacr.power_model` answer the question *"given these sixteen parameters, how well does the model recover the hits?"*. The question a screener actually asks is *"how many cells per well, and how many microplate sample positions, do I need to detect an effect of size X?"*. This module is the translation between the two, and it is deliberately separate from the widget so the translation can be tested without a QApplication — the same split ``pca_model`` / ``pca`` and ``pivot_spec`` / ``tabulate`` already use.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.power_design#1

The question a screener actually asks is *"how many cells per well, and how many wells, do I need to detect an effect of size X?"*. This module is the translation between the two, and it is deliberately separate from the widget so the translation can be tested without a QApplication — the same split ``pca_model`` / ``pca`` and ``pivot_spec`` / ``tabulate`` already use.
records.translation: :mod:`spacr.power_simulate` och :mod:`spacr.power_model` svarar på frågan *"med tanke på dessa sexton parametrar, hur väl återvinner modellen träffarna?"*. Frågan en screeningforskare faktiskt frågar är *"hur många celler per brunn, och hur många mikroplattor provpositioner, behöver jag upptäcka en effekt av storlek X?"*. Denna modul är översättningen mellan de två, och det är avsiktligt separat från widgeten så översättningen kan testas utan en QApplication — samma split ``pca_model`` / ``pca`` och ``pivot_spec`` / ``tabulate`` redan använda.

records.context: The sample is **random but reproducible**: the seed is a stable digest of ``"<folder name>|<total sets>|<cap>|<nonce>"`` (:func:`sample_seed`), so the same laboratory microplate at the same cap yields the same sets in this session, the next session, and on another machine or mount point — a preview can be described and returned to. It is deliberately *not* seeded from the clock or from ``hash()``, which is salted per process. Re-rendering never re-draws; only an explicit act does — changing the cap (which is in the seed) or calling :func:`~ImageSetSampler.reshuffle` (which bumps the nonce).
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.preview_controls#48
records.source: The sample is **random but reproducible**: the seed is a stable digest of ``"<folder name>|<total sets>|<cap>|<nonce>"`` (:func:`sample_seed`), so the same plate at the same cap yields the same sets in this session, the next session, and on another machine or mount point — a preview can be described and returned to. It is deliberately *not* seeded from the clock or from ``hash()``, which is salted per process. Re-rendering never re-draws; only an explicit act does — changing the cap (which is in the seed) or calling :func:`~ImageSetSampler.reshuffle` (which bumps the nonce).
records.translation: Provet är **random men reproducerbart**: fröet är en stabil smältpunkt av ``"<folder name>|<total sets>|<cap>|<nonce>"`` (:func:`sample_seed`), så samma laboratoriemikroplatta på samma lock ger samma uppsättningar i denna session, nästa session, och på en annan maskin eller monteringspunkt – en förhandsgranskning kan beskrivas och returneras till. Det är avsiktligt *inte* som utsåts från klockan eller från ``hash()`` som saltas per process. Omblandning aldrig omdragningar; endast en explicit handling gör det – att ändra locket (som är i fröet) eller ringa :func:`~ImageSetSampler.reshuffle` (som stöter nonce).

records.translation: Resultatpanelen kombinerar en klickbar vulkanplott, sorteringsbar koefficienttabell, p-värdehistogram, Q-Q kalibreringsvy, analyskontroller, guide-stödvy, modellsammanfattning och annotation för den valda genen. records.context: Which coefficients every tab draws -- gRNA, Gene or Both -- is the reader's choice, made on the panel beside what it changes. A run fitted at ``level='both'`` fits twice and writes both families into one table, so the gene half needs no re-fit to be seen. The two fits are separate multiple-testing families and are corrected as such, and each row says which fit it came from, so a gene and its guides are distinct rows in the table, on the plot and in the exported copy. A level this run has no rows at says why it has none rather than drawing an empty tab.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.regression_results#2
records.source: Which coefficients every tab draws -- gRNA, Gene or Both -- is the reader's choice, made on the panel beside what it changes. A run fitted at ``level='both'`` fits twice and writes both families into one table, so the gene half needs no re-fit to be seen. The two fits are separate multiple-testing families and are corrected as such, and each row says which fit it came from, so a gene and its guides are distinct rows in the table, on the plot and in the exported copy. A level this run has no rows at says why it has none rather than drawing an empty tab.
records.translation: Vilka koefficienter varje flik drar -- gRNA, Gene eller båda -- är läsarens val, som görs på panelen bredvid vad den ändrar. En körning monterad på ``level='both'`` passar två gånger och skriver båda familjerna i en tabell, Så genen halva behöver ingen om-fit för att ses. De två passar är separata flertestande familjer och korrigeras som sådana, och varje rad säger vilken passar det kom från, Så en gen och dess guider är distinkta rader i tabellen, på diagrammet och i den exporterade kopian. En nivå denna körning har inga rader på säger varför den inte har någon snarare än att rita en tom flik.

records.context: One widget serves two owners. A segmentation preview has four things worth looking at: the image with the outlines on it, the label masks alone, the flow microscope field of view the masks were pooled from, and the cell probability the flow was thresholded at. Mask generation's live preview showed three of them through a dropdown; the plaque preview showed its own four through tabs, drawn by its own code. This module is the one place both can draw them from, so that a change to how a cell probability is coloured reaches both previews at once.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.segmentation_views#1
records.source: One widget serves two owners. A segmentation preview has four things worth looking at: the image with the outlines on it, the label masks alone, the flow field the masks were pooled from, and the cell probability the flow was thresholded at. Mask generation's live preview showed three of them through a dropdown; the plaque preview showed its own four through tabs, drawn by its own code. This module is the one place both can draw them from, so that a change to how a cell probability is coloured reaches both previews at once.
records.translation: En widget tjänar två ägare. En förhandsgranskning av segmenteringen har fyra saker värda att titta på: bilden med konturerna på den, etiketten masker ensam, flödesmikroskopet fältet visa maskerna poolades från, och cellsannolikheten att flödet var tröskel för. records.context: ``parametric`` the response is given a distribution and the p-values come from that distribution's theory. Least squares, the GLM links, the penalised fits and the mixed model. ``robust_semiparametric`` linear models whose coefficients remain parametric but whose loss reduces sensitivity to extreme microplate sample positions. ``rlm``, ``huber`` and ``quantile`` belong to this group; quantile regression leaves the error distribution unspecified. ``rank_based`` fits based on well order rather than response magnitudes. ``rra`` is the nonparametric family in the current inventory.
records.label: spacr.regression_families#2
records.source: ``parametric`` the response is given a distribution and the p-values come from that distribution's theory. Least squares, the GLM links, the penalised fits and the mixed model. ``robust_semiparametric`` linear models whose coefficients remain parametric but whose loss reduces sensitivity to extreme wells. ``rlm``, ``huber`` and ``quantile`` belong to this group; quantile regression leaves the error distribution unspecified. ``rank_based`` fits based on well order rather than response magnitudes. ``rra`` is the nonparametric family in the current inventory.
records.translation: ``parametric`` svaret ges en distribution och p-värdena kommer från den distributionens teori. Minsta kvadrater, GLM-länkarna, de bestraffade passar och den blandade modellen. ``robust_semiparametric`` linjära modeller vars koefficienter förblir parametriska men vars förlust minskar känsligheten för extrema mikroplattor provpositioner. ``rlm``, ``huber`` och ``quantile`` tillhör denna grupp; quantile regression lämnar felfördelningen ospecificerad. ``rank_based`` passar baserat på brunnarnas ordning snarare än respons magnituder. ``rra`` är den icke-parametriska familjen i den aktuella inventeringen.

records.context: The screen workflow historically receives one row per ``(well, gRNA)`` and the low-level estimators receive a conventional wide design matrix. records.label: spacr.regression_layout#1
records.source: The screen pipeline historically receives one row per ``(well, gRNA)`` and the low-level estimators receive a conventional wide design matrix.  These helpers make that boundary explicit and also accept count tables that arrive with one guide per column.  Conversion is deliberately strict: a value is never silently selected when duplicate rows disagree.
records.translation: Screeningens arbetsflöde får historiskt sett en rad per ``(well, gRNA)`` och estimatorerna på låg nivå får en konventionell bred designmatris. Dessa hjälpare gör den gränsen explicit och accepterar också räkna tabeller som anländer med en guide per kolumn. Konvertering är avsiktligt strikt: ett värde väljs aldrig tyst när duplicerade rader inte håller med.

records.context: Pooled from the counts, not averaged from the ratios. A field with three objects and a field with three hundred are not equal evidence, and a mean of per-field precisions treats them as though they were -- so a model that fails on one sparse field is punished as hard as one that fails on a confluent one. Precision, recall and F1 are recomputed from the summed true and false positives; only the per-object means (IoU, Dice, area error) are averaged, weighted by each field's matched-object count.

records.source: Pooled from the counts, not averaged from the ratios. A field with three objects and a field with three hundred are not equal evidence, and a mean of per-field precisions treats them as though they were -- so a model that fails on one sparse field is punished as hard as one that fails on a confluent one. Precision, recall and F1 are recomputed from the summed true and false positives; only the per-object means (IoU, Dice, area error) are averaged, weighted by each field's matched-object count.
records.translation: Sammanslagna från räkningarna, inte i genomsnitt från nyckeltalen. Ett fält med tre objekt och ett fält med 300 är inte lika bevis, och ett medelvärde av precisioner per fält behandlar dem som om de vore -- så en modell som misslyckas på ett glest fält straffas lika hårt som ett som misslyckas på ett konfluent. Precision, återkallande och F1 återberäknas från den summerade sanna och falska positiva; endast per-objekt betyder (IoU, Dice, area fel) är medelvärden, viktas av varje fälts matchade-objekt räkna.

records.context: ``measure_crop`` is the expensive step in spaCR: it opens every mask, cuts every object out of every image data channel, computes hundreds of features per object and writes them to SQLite. On a full laboratory microplate that is hours. A laboratory microplate whose segmentation collapsed — an image data channel out of focus, a diameter two-fold wrong, a confluent monolayer that fused into slabs — costs exactly the same hours and then produces a measurement table that has to be thrown away. The failure is obvious from the masks alone, but checking them by hand means opening a thousand ``.npy`` files. Mask statistics can highlight suspicious microscope fields of view, but cannot establish their cause or validate biological interpretation.
records.label: spacr.seg_qc#2
records.source: ``measure_crop`` is the expensive step in spaCR: it opens every mask, cuts every object out of every channel, computes hundreds of features per object and writes them to SQLite. On a full plate that is hours. A plate whose segmentation collapsed — a channel out of focus, a diameter two-fold wrong, a confluent monolayer that fused into slabs — costs exactly the same hours and then produces a measurement table that has to be thrown away. The failure is obvious from the masks alone, but checking them by hand means opening a thousand ``.npy`` files. Mask statistics can highlight suspicious fields, but cannot establish their cause or validate biological interpretation.
records.translation: ``measure_crop`` är det dyra steget i spaCR: det öppnar varje mask, skär ut varje objekt ur varje bilddatakanal, beräknar hundratals egenskaper per objekt och skriver dem till SQLite. På en fullständig laboratoriemikroplatta som är timmar. En laboratoriemikroplate vars segmentering kollapsade – en bilddata kanal ur fokus, en diameter tvåfaldigt fel, ett konfluent monoskikt som smälts till plattor – kostar exakt samma timmar och sedan producerar en mättabell som måste kastas bort. Misslyckandet är uppenbart enbart från maskerna, men att kontrollera dem för hand innebär att öppna tusen ``.npy`` filer. Maskstatistik kan belysa misstänkta mikroskopiska synfält, men kan inte fastställa deras orsak eller validera biologisk tolkning.

records.context: The identifier-to-identifier form of :meth:`Selection.mask_for`, for a view that holds an array of structured-data names rather than the frame they came from — a scatter plot, a UMAP that derived its point identity once at load, a tree. A bare ``Index.isin`` tests exact equality, which fails when one side of a link states an object type and the other does not: a table publishing ``…_f1_cell1`` would match **nothing at all** in a UMAP whose points are keyed ``…_f1_1``. This function applies the same type-specificity rules as :meth:`Selection.mask_for` instead.
records.label: spacr.selection.match_keys#1
records.source: The key-to-key form of :meth:`Selection.mask_for`, for a view that holds an array of keys rather than the frame they came from — a scatter plot, a UMAP that derived its point identity once at load, a tree. A bare ``Index.isin`` tests exact equality, which fails when one side of a link states an object type and the other does not: a table publishing ``…_f1_cell1`` would match **nothing at all** in a UMAP whose points are keyed ``…_f1_1``. This function applies the same type-specificity rules as :meth:`Selection.mask_for` instead.
records.translation: Identifier-till-identifier form av :meth:`Selection.mask_for`, för en vy som innehåller en rad strukturerade data namn snarare än den ram de kom från - ett spridningsdiagram, en UMAP som härledde sin punkt identitet en gång vid belastning, ett träd. En bare ``Index.isin`` testar exakt jämlikhet, som misslyckas när en sida av en länk anger en objekttyp och den andra inte: en tabell publicera ``…_f1_cell1`` skulle matcha **ingenting alls** i en UMAP vars punkter är knappade ``…_f1_1``. Denna funktion tillämpar samma typspecifika regler som :meth:`Selection.mask_for` istället.

records.context: Two stacked panels share one log-scaled threshold axis: gRNAs per well above, well retention and collision rate below. Two panels rather than a twin y-axis because the quantities have nothing in common — a count and two percentages — and overlaying them puts the flat 100% retention line on top of the frame, where it cannot be read. The derived threshold is a labelled vertical line carrying its own numeric value in both panels, so the derived value can be read without the axis.

records.translation: Två staplade paneler har en logskalad tröskelaxel: gRNAs per brunn ovanför, brunnsretention och kollisionshastighet under. records.context: Plaque analysis accepts a folder of TIFF images, or existing masks beneath that folder, plus Cellpose settings and a bundled, catalogue, or local plaque model.  Recruitment starts from a spaCR ``measurements.db`` containing joined cell, nucleus, pathogen, and cytoplasm features; it needs a fluorescence image data channel, object filters, and laboratory microplate metadata that assign cell type, pathogen, and treatment.  Invasion and Replication both need one row per segmented parasite in a measurement table and condition metadata.  Invasion additionally needs the outside- and total-stain image data channels and preferably known control microplate sample positions; Replication needs a defensible ``vacuole_key`` or spatial-linking distance. The Cellpose utilities require paired images and masks for training/testing, or an image folder and model path for inference.
records.label: spacr.submodules#4
records.source: Plaque analysis accepts a folder of TIFF images, or existing masks beneath that folder, plus Cellpose settings and a bundled, catalogue, or local plaque model.  Recruitment starts from a spaCR ``measurements.db`` containing joined cell, nucleus, pathogen, and cytoplasm features; it needs a fluorescence channel, object filters, and plate metadata that assign cell type, pathogen, and treatment.  Invasion and Replication both need one row per segmented parasite in a measurement table and condition metadata.  Invasion additionally needs the outside- and total-stain channels and preferably known control wells; Replication needs a defensible ``vacuole_key`` or spatial-linking distance. The Cellpose utilities require paired images and masks for training/testing, or an image folder and model path for inference.
records.translation: Plackanalys accepterar en mapp med TIFF bilder, eller befintliga masker under den mappen, plus Cellpose inställningar och en buntad, katalog, eller lokal plackmodell. Rekrytering startar från en spaCR ``measurements.db`` som innehåller sammanfogade egenskaper cell, kärna, patogen, och cytoplasma; den behöver en fluorescens bilddatakanal, objektfilter och laboratoriemikroplatta metadata som tilldelar celltyp, patogen och behandling. Invasion och Replication behöver både en rad per segmenterad parasit i en mättabell och tillstånd metadata. Invasionen behöver dessutom externa- och totalhållna bilddatakanaler och helst kända kontroll mikroplate provpositioner; Replicering behöver en defensibel ``vacuole_key`` eller rumsligt länkavstånd. Verktygen Cellpose kräver parade bilder och masker för utbildning/testning, eller en bildmapp och modellväg för slutledning.

records.context: Plaque analysis writes ``<src>/masks/plaques_analysis.db`` with ``summary``, ``stats``, and ``details`` tables.  Recruitment returns per-object and per-well DataFrames and writes their CSVs and plots.  Invasion returns per-parasite classifications, per-microscope field of view thresholds and QC, per-well efficiencies, condition summaries and comparisons, controls, and figures; saved runs place those artifacts under ``results/analyze_invasion``. Replication returns per-vacuole counts, well and condition distributions, pairwise and omnibus statistics, figures, and the grouping method actually used, with saved output under ``results/analyze_replication``.  Model utilities produce trained weights, evaluation tables, masks, and object summaries as appropriate.

Invasion returnerar klassificeringar per parasit, per mikroscope-fält av sikttrösklar och QC, effektivitet per brunn, konditionssammanfattningar och jämförelser, kontroller och siffror; sparade körs dessa artefakter under ``results/analyze_invasion``. records.context: The analysis unit matters.  Invasion is inferred from *absence* of outside stain, so weak staining can only inflate the invaded fraction; thresholds are therefore recorded per field and statistics use microplate sample positions rather than treating parasites from one microplate sample position as independent replicates.  Replication groups by vacuole, not by host cell, because one cell can contain several vacuoles; 3, 5, 6, and 7 parasites remain in an explicit non-power-of-two QC bucket instead of being rounded into a biologically expected class.  Plaque area is calibrated against the microplate sample position scale when available, so comparisons should retain the acquisition metadata that defines that scale.
records.label: spacr.submodules#9
records.source: The analysis unit matters.  Invasion is inferred from *absence* of outside stain, so weak staining can only inflate the invaded fraction; thresholds are therefore recorded per field and statistics use wells rather than treating parasites from one well as independent replicates.  Replication groups by vacuole, not by host cell, because one cell can contain several vacuoles; 3, 5, 6, and 7 parasites remain in an explicit non-power-of-two QC bucket instead of being rounded into a biologically expected class.  Plaque area is calibrated against the well scale when available, so comparisons should retain the acquisition metadata that defines that scale.
records.translation: Analysgruppen är viktig. Invasion härleds från *absence* av utsidesfärgning, så svag färgning kan bara blåsa upp den invaderade fraktionen; Tröskelvärden registreras därför per fält och statistik använder mikroplattors provpositioner i stället för att behandla parasiter från ett mikroplattorprov som oberoende replikat. Replikeringsgrupper med vakuol, inte med värdcell, eftersom en cell kan innehålla flera vakuoleer. 3, 5, 6 och 7 parasiter förblir i en explicit icke-kraft-av-två QC hink istället för att avrundas till en biologiskt förväntad klass. Plackarean kalibreras mot mikroplattans provpositionsskala när sådan finns tillgänglig, så jämförelser bör behålla de förvärvsmetadata som definierar den skalan.

records.label: spacr.suggest#3
records.source: Rules that protect the annotations
records.translation: Regler som skyddar annoteringarna

records.context: 1. A suggestion is never confusable with a decision. Suggestions are stored as their own values -- a suggested 1 becomes 11 -- so nothing that reads the annotation column can mistake one for a human's answer, and a processing session that goes wrong is undone by deleting a value rather than by remembering which rows were touched. 2. A suggestion never overwrites an annotation. Writes carry ``IS NULL``. Not when the model is confident, not on a repeat execution. A human's labels are the ground truth the model was fitted on; losing one silently would cost hours and would not be noticed until a processing session came out wrong. 3. There is no confidence floor; the order carries the uncertainty. Every unannotated extracted image region gets a suggestion, sorted most-confident first, and the reviewer stops where they stop agreeing. A threshold would make that decision with an arbitrary number. 4. A judgement is recorded, not inferred. Confirming a suggestion turns it into an ordinary label and rejecting one clears it -- and both are written down beside the column, in ``<column>_verdict``, as the class that was confirmed (``+c``) or rejected (``-c``). A rejection is information the next round can train on -- "not class 1" is an example of class 2 in a two-class column -- whereas a NULL would record nothing. The verdict column is added the first time a source is opened, so tables made before it existed gain it without a migration step.
records.label: spacr.suggest#4
records.source: 1. A suggestion is never confusable with a decision. Suggestions are stored as their own values -- a suggested 1 becomes 11 -- so nothing that reads the annotation column can mistake one for a human's answer, and a run that goes wrong is undone by deleting a value rather than by remembering which rows were touched. 2. A suggestion never overwrites an annotation. Writes carry ``IS NULL``. Not when the model is confident, not on a re-run. A human's labels are the ground truth the model was fitted on; losing one silently would cost hours and would not be noticed until a run came out wrong. 3. There is no confidence floor; the order carries the uncertainty. Every unannotated crop gets a suggestion, sorted most-confident first, and the reviewer stops where they stop agreeing. A threshold would make that decision with an arbitrary number. 4. A judgement is recorded, not inferred. Confirming a suggestion turns it into an ordinary label and rejecting one clears it -- and both are written down beside the column, in ``<column>_verdict``, as the class that was confirmed (``+c``) or rejected (``-c``). A rejection is information the next round can train on -- "not class 1" is an example of class 2 in a two-class column -- whereas a NULL would record nothing. The verdict column is added the first time a source is opened, so tables made before it existed gain it without a migration step.
records.translation: 1. Ett förslag är aldrig konfusibelt med ett beslut. Förslag lagras som sina egna värden -- en föreslagen 1 blir 11 -- så ingenting som läser annoteringkolumnen kan misstaga en för en människas svar, och en behandling session som går fel ångras genom att ta bort ett värde snarare än genom att komma ihåg vilka rader som rördes. 2. Ett förslag skriver aldrig över en annotering. Skriver bär ``IS NULL``. Inte när modellen är säker, inte på en upprepad körning. En människas etiketter är den grundsanning som modellen var monterad på; att förlora ett tyst skulle kosta timmar och skulle inte märkas förrän en bearbetningssession kom ut fel. 3. Det finns inget förtroendegolv; ordningen bär osäkerheten. Varje icke-annoterad extraherad bildregion får ett förslag, sorterade mest självsäkra först, och granskaren stannar där de slutar komma överens. En tröskel skulle göra det beslutet med ett godtyckligt tal. 4. En bedömning registreras, inte härleds. Bekräftar ett förslag förvandlar det till en vanlig etikett och förkastar en rensar det - och båda skrivs ner bredvid kolumnen, i ``<column>_verdict``, som klassen som bekräftades (``+c``) eller förkastas (``-c``). Ett avslag är information som nästa omgång kan träna på -- "not class 1" är ett exempel på klass 2 i en kolumn av två klasser -- medan en NULL skulle spela in ingenting. Domkolumnen läggs till första gången en källa öppnas, så tabeller som gjorts innan den existerade vinner den utan att någon migrering.
